articleTitle: Adaptive speed planning for Unmanned Vehicle Based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of frequent deceleration of unmanned vehicles when approaching obstacles, this article uses a Deep Q-Network (DQN) and its extension, the Double Deep Q-Network (DDQN), to develop a local navigation system that adapts to obstacles while maintaining optimal speed planning. By integrating improved reward functions and obstacle angle determination methods, the system demonstrates significant enhancements in maneuvering capabilities without frequent decelerations. Experiments conducted in simulated environments with varying obstacle densities confirm the effectiveness of the proposed method in achieving more stable and efficient path planning.

articleTitle: Java Web Programming with ChatGPT
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), ChatGPT is an important technical breakthrough in the field of natural language processing (NLP). ChatGPT, as a large-scale language model, focuses on the task of conversation generation and has attracted wide attention in academia and industry. Meanwhile, it brings opportunities and challenges to Java Web programming. Compared with previous studies that investigated the ability of ChatGPT to solve small-scale Java programming problems that emphasized basic concepts, this paper explores how well ChatGPT can produce sequential Java code to construct the complete Web project. A series of experiments based on the user-login study case are conducted to evaluate the performance of ChatGPT-generated code. Through thorough experimental analysis, the generated code is characterized by high readability, good quality, and complete functionality. However, ChatGPT's performance degrades when instructions contain limited text information. In conclusion, ChatGPT has the potential to be an important assistant for developers, greatly improving efficiency and productivity in the software development process.

articleTitle: Research Progress and Application of Multi-Sensor Data Fusion Technology in AGVs
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Multi-sensor data fusion technology, which utilizes information from different sensors, combines algorithms and models to improve system performance and accuracy, has been widely applied in various fields. However, Automated Guided Vehicles (AGVs) often rely on multiple sensors to achieve autonomous navigation, positioning, and obstacle avoidance functions. Multi-sensor data fusion technology can assist AGVs in perceiving the surrounding environment more accurately, achieving precise navigation, and avoiding obstacles. Such compound applications can enhance the autonomy and reliability of AGVs, making them more suitable for industrial automation and logistics. In this regard, by combining the performance of single-sensor technology, AGV technology, and multi-sensor data fusion technology in AGVs, this paper comprehensively summarizes the relevant research and application achievements of scholars in the field of AGV multi-sensor data fusion technology in recent years. It also briefly expounds on the future development and prospects of this technology, providing an important theoretical basis for the application research of multi-sensor data fusion technology in AGVs.

articleTitle: Research on Extension of Stability Domain of Convertor Parameters Based on Voltage FCS-MPC
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Finite control set model predictive control (FCS-MPC) is advantaged with intuitive modeling, no-current PID controller, PWM, and multi-objective task optimization. However, the performance of FCS-MPC depends on the accuracy of the system model and is inevitably affected by the model parameter mismatch. To further improve the parameter robustness of FCS-MPC and analyze the parameter stability domain of the system, a finite control set model predictive voltage control (FCS-MPVC) strategy is proposed in this paper based on the prediction time domain extension under the guidance of the basic principle of model prediction and the idea of beat free control. Firstly, the parameter stability domain of the system is analyzed using the root locus method, and then qualitatively analyzed. On this basis, the parameter stability domain is further extended by improving the order of the voltage prediction model and the control delay compensation, thus widening the application range of a set of coefficients. The simulation and experimental results verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the FCS-MPVC control strategy proposed in this paper.

Author Keywords: finite control set model predictive voltage control

articleTitle: Obstacle Avoidance Planning Algorithm for Robotic Arm Motion Path Based on Fuzzy Variable Structure Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The range of motion of the robotic arm can be freely adjusted, but obtaining an accurate motion law is challenging. This leads to issues such as poor planning effectiveness, long planning paths, and time-consuming planning. To address these challenges, we propose a fuzzy variable structure compensation-based algorithm for robotic arm motion path obstacle avoidance planning. Firstly, the algorithm analyzes the dynamics of the robotic arm and combines the results with fuzzy variable structure to compensate for the torque of the robotic arm. Then, it utilizes the Q-learning algorithm to calculate compensation control results and determine the best planning strategy for the path. Finally, this strategy is implemented to complete obstacle avoidance path planning for the robotic arm. Experimental results demonstrate that this algorithm provides greater accuracy, shorter planning paths, and reduced planning time.

articleTitle: Linear Regression-Based Dead-Time Identification Strategy for PMSM Using Static Voltage Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper analyzes the dead-time effect and error voltage model of the inverter in permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs). Based on the current response to d-axis voltage injection when the motor is stationary, a linear regression-based identification model for equivalent dead-time using d-axis voltage injection is proposed. The identification method does not require knowledge of the motor's electrical parameters and offers rapid identification speed. It can accurately identify the equivalent dead time across different motors. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method can accurately identify the equivalent dead time under both nominal and non-nominal motor parameters, consistent with the actual inverter dead-time error.

articleTitle: Research on Temperature Field of Distribution Transformer Based on Distributed Optical Fiber Sensing Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As an important electrical equipment in power system, the temperature monitoring of transformer has always been one of the research focuses of on-line monitoring of electrical equipment. However, at present, most of the measurement of transformer temperature is difficult to realize the in-situ monitoring of its internal high temperature area. With the advancement of distributed optical fiber sensing technologies, optical fibers are tiny and resistant to electromagnetic interference, making them ideal for internal monitoring of electrical equipment. Thus, in this research, the optical fiber transformer is created by winding the optical fiber outside the transformer winding, and the internal temperature of the transformer is determined using Brillouin scattering optical time domain analysis technology. The measured temperature data from the temperature increase test are obtained, confirming the approach's practicality and significantly improving the ability to feel the transformer's interior temperatures.

articleTitle: Research on a New Type of Three-Axis Precision Casting Stainless Steel Vacuum Mud Refining Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to the time-consuming, material consuming, and high depreciation rates that traditional vacuum mud refiners encounter during the mixing, mixing, kneading, and extrusion molding processes. In response to the above issues, this article analyzes the motion state of the spiral blades of the vacuum mud refining machine during mixing and stirring. The customized full component precision casting process is used to improve the dimensional accuracy of the casting. On the basis of the original only two upper stirring spiral shafts, a squeezing screw shaft is added to the lower part to transform the traditional single axis and double axis mud refining machines. A three-axis precision casting stainless steel vacuum mud refining machine model is established using UG software. The force analysis of the large diameter semi moon shaped mud mixing impeller and the spiral mud mixing shaft is carried out through NX CAE finite element analysis. Finally, the effectiveness of this study is verified. The results show that during the operation of the precision casting three-axis vacuum mud refining machine, the hardness and wear resistance of the large diameter half moon shaped mud mixing impeller, spiral mud mixing shaft and other workpieces are significantly enhanced, and there are no obvious surface or internal deformation defects. While ensuring the quality of the mud, the extrusion efficiency of the mud is also correspondingly improved. This proves that the new three-axis precision casting stainless steel vacuum mud refining machine combines precision casting technology with the three-axis vacuum structure to improve the extrusion efficiency of the mud, which can meet the industrial needs of high quality and high efficiency.

Author Keywords: Three axis precision casting stainless steel vacuum mud refining machine

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influence of Track Spectrum on the Secondary Suspension of Heavy-Duty Locomotives
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As the main track excitation model in train simulation, the influence of track spectrum on the dynamic behavior of the secondary suspension of heavy-duty locomotives is worth exploring. Based on the full degree of freedom train system dynamics simulation platform, the dynamic response of the secondary suspension system to the coasting of a 10000 ton heavy-duty locomotive is studied by constructing a secondary suspension model and a track spectrum model. Research has shown that there is little difference in the dynamic response of the secondary suspension system under numerical simulation of German high disturbance spectrum using the trigonometric series method and frequency domain power spectrum sampling method, and their response peaks are also not significantly different; The track spectrum has a significant impact on the dynamic response of the secondary suspension system, and different types of track spectra can also result in significant differences. The hydraulic devices of China's three major line spectra have the highest peak lateral dynamic response, while the spring devices of the US Level 5 spectrum have the highest peak lateral, vertical, and hydraulic device vertical response.

articleTitle: A Wide-Range Dual-Bridge Non-Isolated Three-Port Converter Based on P1S3 Architecture
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To address the issue of narrow port voltage range in existing three-port converters, this paper presents a non-isolated three-port converter (TPC) topology based on the P1S3 architecture, which can achieve boost and buck functions between any two ports. A competitive control strategy between the output voltage regulator and the battery discharge regulator is adopted to adjust the voltage of input terminal, energy storage terminal and load terminal in a wide range, while reducing the number of required switches. The simulation results show that the average efficiency of TPC based on the P1S3 architecture in a wide operating range reaches 94.30%, which verifies the feasibility of the theoretical analysis of the TPC.

articleTitle: Improved Cooperative Search Algorithm with Multi-Strategy Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Proposed in response to the slow convergence speed, limited search space, and susceptibility to local optima of the basic cooperative search algorithm when dealing with complex optimization problems, the improved cooperative search algorithm with multi-strategy fusion is introduced. By using an improved Circle chaotic mapping to initialize individual positions of the employees, the diversity of the population is enhanced, addressing the issues of uneven population. By using an improved Circle chaotic mapping to initialize individual positions of the employees, the diversity of the population is enhanced, addressing the issues of uneven population distribution and insufficient search space. By combining it with the Sparrow algorithm, global guidance is introduced to accelerate the convergence speed of the algorithm. The foraging strategy of the Artificial Rabbit algorithm is integrated to the foraging strategy of the Artificial Rabbit algorithm is integrated to balance the algorithm's local development and search capabilities. Furthermore, the simulated annealing mechanism is incorporated into the position updating process to help the algorithm escape from local optima. Through a comparison using 5 test cases, the results demonstrate that the Improved Cooperative Search Algorithm (ICSA) exhibits superior optimization performance. The algorithm, both before and after improvement, is combined with the Kernel Extreme Learning Algorithm (KEA). The algorithm, both before and after improvement, is combined with the Kernel Extreme Learning Machine to predict the total frictional force of bowstring contact, and the results confirm the feasibility and superiority of the improved algorithm.

articleTitle: Research on grinding parameters for machining spiral grooves on solid carbide end mills using an arc-shaped edge of the grinding wheel
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The spiral groove of the overall cemented carbide end mill is an important structural feature that significantly affects its performance. The main metrics for the spiral groove are the core thickness radius and the rake angle. In this paper, we propose the use of grinding with a wheel with a circular arc-shaped edge to create the grooves, based on the enveloping principle. We establish a mathematical model for grinding with a wheel with a circular arc-shaped edge using an analytical approach, and employ a two-step binary search method to determine the wheel posture parameters for different core thicknesses and rake angles. By combining the posture parameters with the machine tool KTooLG3515's structure, we generate G-code and conduct simulation machining in Vericut. We compare and analyze the accuracy of groove formation between circular arc edges and straight edges of the grinding wheel, thus verifying the accuracy of the algorithm and the mathematical model.

articleTitle: Frequency response Analysis of Doubly-Fed Variable Speed Pumped Storage Unit Based on Simplified Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Doubly-fed variable speed pumped storage units (DFVSPSUs) have good regulatory performance and have infinite potential to solve the problem of frequency stability caused by changes in renewable energy sources. However, the system is a nonlinear system with strong coupling of hydraulic electric control, and the model is relatively complex, so it is difficult to get the analytical solution by direct analysis. Therefore, the frequency response characteristics of DFVSPSUs are studied by establishing a simplified model. Firstly, the topological structure and operation characteristics of the variable speed pumped storage unit (VSPSU) using power control method are analyzed, and the simplified frequency modulation model of the VSPSU is established. Then, the frequency modulation model of power grid including constant speed pumped storage unit and DFVSPSU is established respectively, and the model is simplified by order reduction. Finally, a comparative analysis of the two power systems is carried out to further explain the contribution of VSPSUs to the stability of the power grid. The results show that after the DFVSPSU participates in frequency modulation, the damping characteristics of the system are improved, and the damping ratio is increased by 6.26%.

articleTitle: Construction and Research of Intelligent Manufacturing System Components Based on Agent Concept
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This research paper proposes a new perspective on smart manufacturing systems using Agent components. It shows that integrating multi-agent systems into production lines can streamline the design and assembly process, thereby improving the overall efficiency and quality of the manufacturing system. This novel approach is particularly beneficial for line manufacturing seeking to meet mass customization needs. The successful implementation of the granule filling automated assembly line multi-agent system provides a practical example for other industries to leverage the advantages of intelligent manufacturing. The findings highlight the potential of smart manufacturing systems to significantly improve operational efficiency and quality, providing a scalable and sustainable future for manufacturing.

articleTitle: Design of LoRa-Based Environmental Monitoring Communication System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A real-time environmental monitoring system based on the LoRa wireless networking communication has been designed, which is capable of monitoring temperature, humidity, air quality, and water line, with built-in alarm functionality. This system consists of three parts: the upper computer, gateway, and monitoring terminal, utilizing the LoRa module as a communication carrier for real-time information transmission. The monitoring terminal comprises multiple acquisition modules, which transmit information to the gateway through LoRa networking. The LoRa gateway receives and processes data uploaded by monitoring terminals. The LoRa gateway receives and processes data uploaded by monitoring terminals, enabling the upper computer to display data in real time through serial port communication. Additionally, automatic alarms are triggered when the water level or smoke exceeds the threshold values. This system has been confirmed to be effective, economical, accurate, and meets the design requirements. This design overcomes limitations of traditional wireless and Bluetooth signals, such as limited coverage range and high power consumption, enabling long-distance transmission. It can be applied in scenarios such as environmental protection and smart agriculture to improve production efficiency.

articleTitle: Identification of Low-Voltage Distribution Substation Based on DTW Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A method is proposed for identifying the topology of low-voltage distribution substation with errors based on dynamic time warping (DTW) distance and cluster analysis. This method first uses DTW distance to measure the similarity between voltage curves of users, and then performs cluster analysis on the voltage curves of users using the minimum-maximum distance principle to identify the substation to which low-voltage users belong and to distinguish users within the same substation. The correctness and effectiveness of the proposed method are verified by simulation results.

articleTitle: Research on Triple Distance and Triple Velocity Measurement Methods for Laser Trackers
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In response to the problem that the indoor baseline field with limited space cannot measure the laser tracker in full range, sampling three pyramid prisms in the article expands the measurement range of the laser tracker by three times and increases the measurement speed by three times. Through experiments, it was found that under static measurement conditions, the indication error of laser tracking in the full range is -42.5μm, and the measurement repeatability of a single point is 1.9 μ m. This can meet the measurement needs of laser trackers. In dynamic measurement, the motion speed of the slide is 120 mm/s, and the measurement speed of the laser tracker is 359.99 mm/s, achieving a speed triple. The repeatability of the laser tracker in equal interval measurement (10mm) is 0.3347mm, in equal interval measurement (20mm), the repeatability of the measurement interval is 0.2903mm, in equal sampling frequency measurement (50Hz), the repeatability of local velocity is 3.21 mm/s, and in equal sampling frequency measurement (100Hz), the repeatability of local velocity is 1.87mm/s. By using three pyramid prisms, the laser tracker can achieve a threefold increase in static distance measurement and a threefold increase in dynamic measurement speed, which has broad application prospects and reference significance.

articleTitle: Support Segmentation Based on the Slice for Ceramic Stereolithography
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Stereolithography (SL) is one of the important Additive Manufacturing (AM) technologies for ceramic parts with complex structures. In order to ensure the manufacturability of the printing model, the addition of support is essential, especially for non-contact support designed for Ceramic Stereolithography (CSL). However, due to the shrinkage caused by photopolymerization, large solid supports may cause warping phenomenon, which poses difficulties to the printing process and post-processing of parts. Therefore, a slice-based support segmentation method is proposed. Firstly, pre-partitioning for primary non-contact support is carried out by the regular grid to get the secondary support, and then neighborhood connection sequence search method is design to merge the support bodies with mechanical problems, obtaining final support segmentation results within the deformation requirements range, eliminating the adverse effects caused by large solid support. Topology reconstruction is used twice to separate independent non-contact supports that are topologically disconnected. The feasibility and practicality of this method have been verified through testing on different cases.

articleTitle: Optimization of LSTM based on Gray Wolf Optimization Algorithm for Part Error Compensation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the field of precision manufacturing, error compensation of parts is the key to improve product quality and manufacturing efficiency. This paper presents a Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM) model based on the Gray Wolf optimization algorithm designed to optimize part error compensation. First, we introduce the sources of part errors and their impact on the manufacturing process. Then, we elaborate the application of LSTM network in predicting and compensating part errors by selecting appropriate features through correlation analysis. Through experiments, we verify the effectiveness of the Gray Wolf optimization-based LSTM model in part error prediction and compensation. The experimental results show that compared with the traditional method, the model in this paper has a significant improvement in both error prediction accuracy and compensation efficiency.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization under Electromagnetic Launch System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the continuous progress of electromagnetic launch technology, it has now entered the engineering application stage. The launch overload, efficiency, volume and weight of the electromagnetic launch system will affect the engineering application of the whole launch system. This paper starts from the efficiency and carries out the research of multi-parameter optimal design. Adopting the Nondominated Sorting Genetic Algorithm II (NSGA-II), multiple variable factors affecting the electromagnetic rail launch system are taken as the parameters of the algorithm for multi-objective optimization, so as to achieve the maximization of the armature muzzle velocity and launch efficiency of the Electromagnetic Launch system. The establishment of an accurate model verifies that the algorithm has good accuracy and can further improve the efficiency.

articleTitle: A Novel Graded Pressure Equalizing Control Strategy for MMC Submodule
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) has advantages such as low switching frequency, adjustable system output voltage and power level, and modular design, which are attributed to the cascaded structure of its sub-modules. When there is a large fluctuation in the capacitor voltages of the sub-modules and energy distribution among them is uneven, it can cause distortion in the output waveform. Therefore, balancing control of MMC sub-module capacitor voltages becomes crucial. This paper proposes a hierarchical voltage equalization control strategy that achieves balance by superimposing correction quantities on the capacitor voltages. Detailed analysis and explanations are provided for each component, and simulation results validate the effectiveness of this control strategy in achieving capacitor voltage balance.

articleTitle: Bearing Fault Diagnosis Based on the Improved Residual Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem that the samples of fault data in bearing fault diagnosis account for a relatively small proportion in the dataset, which leads to a low correct rate of fault diagnosis, a bearing fault diagnosis method based on CNNLSTM with attention mechanism (SE-1DCNN-LSTM) and multichannel residual one-dimensional convolutional neural network (RES-M1DCNN) is proposed. First, the training set of one-dimensional data of bearings is input into the network, and the combined network of SE-CNN-LSTM with attention mechanism and multi-channel RES-M1DCNN is utilized for feature extraction. SE-CNN-LSTM first extracts the more important temporal signals of the fault data by using the attention mechanism, and then inputs the extracted signals into the multichannel residual network. The multi-channel network structure improves the feature extraction capability and adaptability of the network by increasing the width of the network and expanding the receptive field. The residual connection retains the shallow features while extracting the deep features, which are integrated in the multi-channel output and input to the Softmax layer for classification, and then classify the bearing vibration timing signals. This paper compares different fault diagnosis models and proves that the fault diagnosis model combining SE-CNN-LSTM and RES-M1DCNN has improved the correct rate in bearing fault diagnosis, which verifies the effectiveness of this model.

articleTitle: Analysis and Compensation of Reverse Clearance of Feed Axis of Pipe Bender
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The reverse clearance is a critical factor affecting the accuracy of the feed axis in pipe bending machines, necessitating thorough investigation to enhance feed axis precision. Initially, an analysis was conducted to identify the primary factors influencing reverse clearance. Subsequently, an experimental platform was constructed utilizing components such as a laser interferometer to measure the reverse clearance of the feed axis in the pipe bending machine. The measurement data were then processed to calculate the reverse deviation and average reverse deviation. Following this, a segmented measurement and compensation approach were employed to reduce the reverse clearance of the feed axis in the pipe bending machine. Finally, a comparison of the reverse clearance before and after compensation is conducted to validate the effectiveness of this compensation method.

articleTitle: Optimization Method for Joint Maintenance Work Order Scheduling of Power Grid Transmission and Distribution Equipment Based on Improved Bee Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: When power transmission, transformer and distribution equipment is running, it is easy to fall into the local optimal solution to solve the objective function of joint maintenance work order scheduling optimization. Therefore, optimization method for joint maintenance work order scheduling of power grid transmission and distribution equipment based on improved bee colony algorithm is proposed. The entity relationship triplet including equipment, personnel and resources is introduced to generate the joint maintenance work order label of power grid transmission, transformation and distribution equipment; According to these labels, an optimal scheduling scheme is found by improving the bee colony algorithm, and an optimization objective function is constructed. The same elements in two people are kept by searching for new honey sources, and then the improved new honey source search is used to solve the optimization objective function of joint maintenance work order scheduling of power grid transmission, transformer and distribution equipment, and the optimization results are obtained. The experimental results show that this method has higher throughput, smaller average absolute error and higher response efficiency when it is used to process the combined maintenance work order of power transmission, transformer and distribution equipment.

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis of Key Components of a Turret in a Single-Point Mooring System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The internal turret is the main structure of single-point mooring technology, and this paper takes the "Nanhai Endeavour" FPSO as the research object, firstly introduces the main components of the internal turret, then analyzes the working environment of the internal turret, determines the working conditions, and carries out the load design according to the working conditions. Then, the static strength analysis of the main structure of the swivel stack and the slideway beam was carried out in ABAQUS, and it was proved that the internal turret structure met the strength design requirements. Finally, the stability of the swivel stack is analyzed, and the buckling mode is analyzed to prove that the slip ring stack meets the stability requirements. Through the static strength analysis, fatigue analysis and stability analysis of the FPSO internal turret of Nanhai Endeavour, this paper proves that the structural strength meets the requirements, and provides some theoretical support and practical guidance for the development of the internal turret.

articleTitle: Mechanical Fault Diagnosis of Transformer Windings Based on VMD and DBO-SVM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to diagnose mechanical faults of transformer winding looseness more accurately and effectively, a transformer winding looseness fault diagnosis method based on Variational Mode Decomposition (VMD) and Dung Beetle Optimization Algorithm optimized Support Vector Machine (DBO-SVM) is proposed. Firstly, conduct a simulated fault experiment on a 10 kV transformer and measure its vibration signal. Subsequently, the non-stationary vibration signal is decomposed into multiple intrinsic mode functions (IMFs) using VMD, and the energy entropy of each layer of IMF is calculated to form an eigenvector. Finally, the feature vectors are input into the SVM optimized by the DBO to train a classification model and achieve transformer winding loosening fault diagnosis. The research results indicate that the method proposed in this article is suitable for diagnosing loose faults in transformer windings, and its fault recognition accuracy is higher compared to the traditional improved SVM classification model.

Author Keywords: dung beetle optimization support vector machine

articleTitle: Splicing Design Method and Accuracy Analysis of the U-shaped Frame
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The U-shaped frame is a crucial component of the theodolite. The coaxial accuracy of the bearing holes on both sides of the U-shaped frame directly affects the pitch-axis accuracy and further influences the angular measurement precision of the theodolite. The machining of the bearing holes on both sides of the U-shaped frame with a long span requires the use of methods such as a large-stroke boring machine or the assembly and adjustment of the frame's own structure. However, considering various factors such as the manufacturing cost, manufacturing time, and machining precision of the U-shaped frame, neither of the above methods is the optimal solution. This paper proposes a splicing design method for the U-shaped frame based on the principle of one side and two pins positioning. This method solves the problems of low coaxial accuracy and difficult machining of bearing holes in U-shaped frames with long spans. Through multiple splicing accuracy tests of the coaxiality of the bearing holes in a U-shaped frame with a span of 1500 mm, the average coaxiality error of the bearing holes is 0.023 mm, with a maximum value of 0.038 mm, which is less than the theoretical maximum coaxiality error of 0.058 mm. The coaxiality tolerance precision level is close to Grade 5, which meets the requirements for the use of high-precision theodolite.

articleTitle: The Method of Series Arc Fault Detection and Line Selection in the Frequency Converter Load Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The high temperature of series arc fault is one of the main causes of electrical fire. Aiming at the problem that there is no effective protection method for series arc fault (SAF) in the load circuit of industrial frequency converter, a new method of SAF detection and line selection is proposed in this paper. Firstly, the experiments of SAF in different lines are carried out for the load circuit of three-phase frequency converter commonly used in industrial field. Secondly, the improved variational mode decomposition based on the principle of energy convergence is used to adaptively decompose the phase A current signal in the front end of the frequency converter into multiple modal components. The single modal component is multiplied by the energy coefficient and reconstructed to obtain the characteristic enhancement signal of multiple current signals, and the characteristic matrix is established. Thirdly, the feature matrix is divided into blocks, and the kernel principal component analysis is used to reduce the dimension of each matrix, and the matrix composed of the dimension reduction signal is subjected to secondary dimension reduction to construct the fault feature vector. Finally, the support vector (SVM) machine optimized by the pelican algorithm is used to detect and select the series fault arc. The results show that the method can realize the series fault arc detection and line selection of 6 lines in the whole circuit of the frequency converter only by analyzing the A-phase current of the front end of the frequency converter, and the accuracy of detection and line selection is more than 98 %.

articleTitle: Innovative Design of Self-Propelled Forage Harvester Based on Evolutionary Tree
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The self-propelled green fodder harvester is an important machine for livestock feed production, and with the development of science and technology and the increasingly strict requirements of agricultural sustainability and environmental protection, it needs to be continuously optimized and innovated. In this paper, through the use of TRIZ theory, the green forage harvester has carried out functional analysis, maturity analysis and determined the technological life cycle of the machine, so as to construct the evolution tree of the green forage harvester, and through the analysis of the evolution tree, we have obtained the innovation scheme of each device of the green forage harvester. The innovative solutions were evaluated by the 0-1 scoring method, and the overall design solution of the green fodder harvester was obtained.

articleTitle: Advisor-based Modeling and Simulation of Hybrid Electric Vehicle
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Hybrid electric vehicles use fuel and electricity as energy sources, and are equipped with power batteries as energy storage devices. This not only achieves zero emissions and zero pollution for new energy vehicles, but also takes into account the advantages of long mileage of traditional fuel vehicles. It has gradually become a hot area for the development of new energy vehicles. In order to study the performance of hybrid vehicles, it is necessary to compare them with pure fuel vehicles through simulation testing and observe the changes in vehicle performance indicators, in order to prove that hybrid vehicles have better fuel economy and environmental protection. In this context, this article first elaborates on the main components, fuel saving principles, structural characteristics, and control strategies of hybrid electric vehicles, laying a theoretical foundation for subsequent research. Secondly, taking the Toyota Prius as an example, the parameters of hybrid electric vehicles, motors, and batteries are calculated. Based on this, ADVISOR software is used to construct a model of the vehicle's power, engine, motor, and battery. Finally, the performance of the Prius was verified through simulation testing in ADVISOR software, and compared with pure fuel vehicles. The results showed that in CYC_UDDS and CYC_HWFET Under the two working conditions of HWFET, the Prius is significantly superior to pure fuel vehicles in terms of power and fuel economy, and also has comprehensive advantages in emissions.

articleTitle: Synchronous Jacking Control Method of Multi-Electric Cylinder based on Multivariate Synchronization Error Coupling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of poor accuracy and system jitter in the application of the traditional deviation coupling step-by-step control structure to the synchronous jacking system of multiple electric cylinders, this paper proposes a synchronous control method of eight electric cylinders based on multivariate synchronous error coupling. By analyzing the limitations of the deviation coupling structure in the synchronous control of eight electric cylinders, a mathematical model for the evaluation of synchronous speed error was established, and a coupling control structure based on multiple synchronous errors was proposed combined with the global synchronous error, which simplified the synchronous controller and realized the high-precision synchronous jacking of the eight electric cylinders. Simulation results show that the control method proposed in this paper can improve the synchronous control accuracy of the whole process of the system and reduce the vibration phenomenon of the system.

articleTitle: A Photovoltaic Panel Defect Detection Method Based on the Improved Yolov7
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Photovoltaic panel is the core component of solar power generation system, and its quality and performance directly affect the power generation efficiency and reliability. Aiming at the current PV panel defect detection methods with insufficient accuracy, few defect categories, and the problem that defect targets cannot be localized, this paper proposes a PV panel defect detection model based on the YOLOv7 algorithm. Firstly, the activation function in the downsampling convolution of the model is replaced with FReLU function, secondly, the ELAN structure is reconstructed according to PwConv, and the feature information is connected to the ELAN structure in the neck by jumping to reduce the gradient vanishing and finally, the SEAM attention mechanism is introduced in the connection between the model backbone and the neck. The experimental results show that the MAP of the improved model can reach 97.7%, which is 2.4% higher than the original YOLOv7 model.

articleTitle: Research on Fracture Analysis of Tobacco Machinery Bearing Based on Finite Element Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the process of tobacco production, the long-term stable operation of tobacco machinery is very important, but the bearing which is subjected to reciprocating stress for a long time and overload stress in a short time will lead to fatigue fracture and overload fracture, which seriously affects the stability of the machine. In order to effectively prevent bearing fracture, taking the deep groove ball bearing commonly used in tobacco machinery as the research object, the finite element analysis method is used to analyze the fracture of the bearing, and the overall motion, overall strength, fracture and each component are comprehensively analyzed. According to the calculation results, the ball is the most stressed and easily damaged among the parts. When the diameter of the bearing inner ring is larger, the bearing load is larger and the bearing capacity is stronger. However, correspondingly, the larger the diameter of the inner ring, the more intense the friction generated during transmission, when the load reaches the critical value, there will be cracks, and the fracture will occur in long-term operation. Therefore, you can choose a bearing with a small inner ring diameter, and the ball in each part uses a material with good strength performance to achieve long-term stable operation.

articleTitle: Topology Optimization of the Gearbox Shift Fork Based on the Variable Density Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The shift fork is a part of the automobile transmission, located at the lower end of the handle by flipping the intermediate transmission wheel so that the input/output speed ratio change is an essential structure in automobile transmission. In this paper, the variable shift fork is taken as the research object, and the finite element model of the shifting fork is established based on ABAQUS. The topology optimization of the shifting fork is carried out to meet the strength and stiffness requirements. The optimization model is analyzed according to the actual engineering conditions. The optimization aims to improve the strength and stiffness of the forks to reduce weight and improve performance. By comparing the mass of the optimized transmission fork before and after the optimization, compared with the original model of 1.20kg, the optimized transmission fork mass of 0.84kg is reduced by 0.35kg, and the weight reduction rate is 29.5%. It is indicated that the optimized transmission fork is lighter, stronger, and more efficient, which can improve the performance and economy of the vehicle. Pre-optimization and post-optimization scenarios were compared to determine the best solution. It can provide helpful information to car manufacturers and designers to optimize the design and performance of vehicle transmissions.

articleTitle: On-machine Wear Measurement for Milling Cutter Based on Machine Vision
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As a key factor in the milling process, the wear status of the milling cutter has a significant impact on the machining quality of the workpiece. To detect wear on a milling machine efficiently and precisely, this paper presents the development of a milling machine wear detection system based on machine vision and digital image processing. The system including link mechanisms and industrial camera is designed for auxiliary localization and collection of on-machine images of milling cutter status. The image preprocessing method based on automatic threshold segmentation and Canny edge detection operator is proposed to identify the edge of cutter wear. The Maximum connected domains algorithm is used to screen the wear area of the milling cutter and the amount of wear is obtained based on a calibrated scaling method. Experimental results show that the proposed system is suitable for industrial use due to its rapid detection speed and strong recognition accuracy, which are desirable for engineering applications.

articleTitle: Development of a Distributed Control System Based on PROFINET for SINUMERIK ONE
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In contrast to centralized control systems, distributed control systems possess superior flexibility, reliability, scalability and maintenance convenience, when managing intricate tasks and keeping system stable. To actualize the intricate functionalities of machines and streamline the development and maintenance procedures, a methodology for constructing one kind of distributed control system based on PROFINET communication is devised here. This methodology is specifically designed for the development of field devices with Siemens SINUMERIK ONE systems, which are hardware configured and programmed via the automated programming software TIA Portal. This article focuses on the characteristics and establishment methods of the two communication modes for different real-time requirements in PROFINET IO communication, and introduces the building of device network in detail. By applying this methodology, practical verification was conducted on the bevel gear testing machine. The feasibility of the methodology was substantiated by the successful realization of the anticipated function and the system’s stable operation.

articleTitle: A CBCT Beam-hardening Artifact Correction Method based on Optimal Filter Material Selection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Cone-beam Computed Tomography (CBCT) has been widely used in industrial object inspection and other fields due to its non-destructive imaging characteristics. However, in real scanning, beam hardening artifacts appear in the reconstructed image due to the absorption of low-energy photons by objects. In order to solve the problem that the filter is mostly selected according to experience, and there is no theoretical guidance to select the optimal material filter when using filters to process low-energy photons, this paper proposes a CBCT beam hardening artifact correction method based on the optimal filter material selection. By constructing two evaluation indicators: the total intensity of high-energy photons and the area ratio of high-energy photons to the total amount of photons. Mutual constraints guide the selection of optimal filtering materials. The experimental results show that the details of CBCT images are better restored, beam hardening artifacts are suppressed, and the values of image Contrast (Contrast) and Root Mean Square Error (RSME) are increased by up to 0.3892 and 11.14, respectively.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of Robot Variable Stiffness Dual-Mode Actuator Based on Magnetorheological Fluid
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the flexibility problem of the robot in the physical contact process, a robot variable stiffness actuator based on magnetorheological fluid is designed, which includes two modes of clutch and braking, which can realize the flexible torque output of the joint and reduce the physical contact impact of the robot. Using the joint simulation of Solidworks, Comsol and Matlab, the relevant simulation experiment coupling analysis of the driver was carried out. The results show that the maximum torque transmitted by the actuator in the clutch mode reaches 68.1 N • m, and the maximum braking torque in the braking mode reaches 112.1 N • m, which can realize the flexible drive of the robot joint with dual-mode variable stiffness.

articleTitle: Real-time Driving Ability Prediction Model Based on GWO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the development of intelligent transportation system, accurate prediction of driver’s real-time driving ability has become the key to ensure road traffic safety and improve driving efficiency. This paper proposes a real-time driving ability prediction model based on grey wolf optimization algorithm (GWO) and long short-term memory neural network (LSTM). The model optimizes the network parameters of LSTM through GWO, improves the prediction accuracy and generalization ability, and compares it with support vector regression (SVR) and classification regression tree (CART) prediction models. The experimental results show that the average coefficient of determination of the GWO-LSTM model is 0.9949, which is greater than 0.9840 of the SVR model and 0.9602 of the CART model. The model has good performance in real-time driving ability prediction and provides strong support for the development of intelligent transportation systems.

articleTitle: Lifetime Analysis of Anchor Bolt Torque Device Based on Workbench and nCode
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Based on fatigue failure theory, CAE model of bolt torque device was established by CATIA. Taking the main factors affecting fatigue durability as the characteristic parameters, the static analysis of gear was carried out. The static dynamic load spectrum was established, and the fatigue life of gear pair was analyzed by nCode based on material S-N curve and Miner linear damage accumulation theory, and the fatigue life of gear pair in each region was obtained. The results show that the maximum stress in the gear transmission process is 605.43MPa, which appears at the root of the tooth, the maximum contact stress meets the strength requirements of the material, and the minimum fatigue life is 1.32×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>, about 7000h, which meets the design requirements.

Author Keywords: Load spectrum calculation Finite element analysis

articleTitle: Design of USV for autonomous recovery of UAV and AUV at sea
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAV), Unmanned Surface Vessels (USV), and Autonomous Underwater Vehicles (AUV) constitute a heterogeneous collaborative task system at sea. The UAV provides extensive surface perception with its highaltitude perspective, while the AUV contributes underwater environmental data with its submersible capabilities. Leveraging the USV's large payload capacity and long endurance, it serves as a recharge and retrieval platform for UAV and AUV. The synergistic advantages of these three components enrich maritime operations and enhance efficiency in sea-based missions. However, the oscillatory response of the USV induced by sea waves significantly impacts the safe recovery of UAV and AUV. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method based on envelope to predict the quiescent period of USV, which integrates predicted USV attitude values with UAV and AUV docking controllers to improve the precision and reliability of the docking system. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is validated through simulation systems and maritime experiments.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Method for Storage Allocation of Multi aisle Warehouses
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Multi aisle warehouses are increasingly being used by modern intelligent logistics. Reasonably optimizing warehouse cargo locations can effectively shorten working hours, improve work efficiency, and reduce logistics costs. A multi objective optimization model was established for the allocation of storage spaces in multi-aisle warehouses, with the optimization objectives of goods in and out efficiency, overall stability of shelves, and load balancing of stackers. A self-adaptive multi population genetic algorithm (AMPGA) is proposed for this model, which introduces a cosine type adaptive genetic operator to dynamically adjust the crossover and mutation rates of individuals in the population. At the same time, different crossover strategies are adopted for each population, and a unidirectional evolutionary reversal operator is introduced to overcome the problems of poor local search ability and premature convergence, making it jump out of local optima and maintain global search ability. The experimental results under different order sizes show that MPGA improves by 2% to 12% compared to SGA optimization, and AMPGA improves by 2% to 14% compared to SGA optimization. Moreover, AMPGA optimization is more significant than MPGA, takes less time, and is more reasonable for the optimization results of storage space.

articleTitle: Distributed Energy Storage SOC Balancing Strategy Based on Adaptive Droop Control with Dynamic Correction Coefficients
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Inconsistent State of Charge (SOC) of parallel Distributed Energy Storage (DES) can cause issues in microgrid stability and energy storage battery lifespan when using conventional Droop with fixed droop coefficients. DES with low SOC value may discharge prematurely and exit from operation, disrupting the microgrid's stable operation. To address this, this paper proposes an adaptive Droop control strategy based on dynamic correction coefficients that consider the local SOC of each DES and coordinate their output, to maintain stable microgrid operation. Its efficacy is confirmed through simulations on the PSCAD/EMTDC platform.

articleTitle: MMC Capacitor Voltage Equalization Control Method for Cyclic Conduction of Submodules
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of high submodule switching frequency and large algorithmic time complexity in the traditional modular multilevel converter (MMC) capacitor voltage equalization control strategy, a capacitor voltage equalization control method with cyclic conduction of submodules is proposed. By setting the upper and lower thresholds of the trigger signal, the capacitive voltage equalization of a fundamental waveform cycle is divided into two processes: cyclic input and sorting input. Within the threshold interval, the submodules are cyclically energized in accordance with the submodule serial number without sorting and comparison; outside the threshold interval, the submodules are sequentially energized by an improved fast sequencing algorithm. and the voltage equalization degree lost in this process is compensated in the sorting input process. In the sorting input process, the signal threshold limits the traversal times of the sorting algorithm, reduces the time complexity of the algorithm, and improves the real-time operation of the controller. Finally, the MMC model is built in MATLAB/Simulink to verify the feasibility and effectiveness of the method.

articleTitle: Data Anomaly Detection in Power System State Estimation Based on Support Vector Machine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To address the significant impact of anomalous data on the performance of power system state estimation, this study proposes a Forecasting-Aided state estimation (FASE) anomaly detection method for power systems based on support vector machines (SVM). Initially, to tackle the issue of poor prediction accuracy in traditional FASE, the method utilizes SVM, leveraging predictive data, measurement data, and estimated values to detect various types of data anomalies, including bad data, load spikes, and single-phase earth faults. Additionally, considering the influence of penalty factors and kernel function parameters on classification accuracy, a grey wolf optimization is employed to optimize SVM parameters, enhancing the accuracy of data anomaly detection while balancing computational speed. Finally, simulation tests on the IEEE 33-bus system demonstrate that the proposed method offers strong universality and real-time capabilities, effectively detecting various types of data anomalies in power systems and improving the performance of state estimation.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Efficient Data Update for Graphical Display on Provincial Platform of the New Generation Substation Centralized Control System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The construction of the provincial platform of the new generation of substation centralized control system continues to advance, the graph, model and date of the provincial platform are formed from the regional centralized control system, and the scale of data storage continues to grow, which puts forward higher requirements in terms of real-time data update and screen operation response ability. In view of the problems of high server load, untimely data update, stuck human-machine screen of workstation, and unsmooth operation response caused by centralized access in the case of large data scale and frequent data changes, an efficient human-machine terminal data update framework is proposed, and the human-machine gateway service is added to the server side to achieve efficient real-time data update through technologies such as subscription/publishing mechanism based on changing data entity messages, shared data pools, and changing data message forwarding. The experimental results show that the human-machine terminal data update using the new framework can better meet the requirements of the provincial centralized control system for large-scale data access and update in terms of server Central Processing Unit(CPU)load rate, real-time data update efficiency, and screen operation fluency.

articleTitle: Harmonic Analysis of the Power System of a Certain Icebreaker Research Ship
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: When the current flows through nonlinear loads in the ship’s power system, a large amount of harmonic current is generated, which reduces the power quality of the ship’s power system and affects the normal operation of the ship’s electrical and electronic equipment and instruments. CCS regulations also have corresponding requirements for the harmonic part of the power system’s power quality. This article takes a certain icebreaking research ship as an example, applies ETAP simulation software to establish a simulation model of the power system of the icebreaking research ship, and conducts harmonic analysis and calculation. The simulation results show that the AFE frequency converter has a good suppression effect on harmonics. The total harmonic distortion rate of the voltage of the 690V and 400V busbars of the icebreaking scientific research ship under various typical Operating conditions is within the specified range, which can provide reference and guidance for harmonic processing of similar ships in the future.

articleTitle: A Parameter Optimisation-Based Fault Extraction Method for MNAD Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of fault feature extraction difficulty of rolling bearings under noise, a Minimum noise amplitude deconvolution (MNAD) algorithm based on parameter optimization is proposed. To solve the problem that the two key parameters of the MNAD algorithm, the filter length T and the fault feature frequency α, are not clear, the parameter search is carried out with the maximum Kurtosis value as the optimization goal. Firstly, select and fix the appropriate filter length to search for the optimal parameters of the fault characteristic frequency; secondly, fix the optimal parameters of the fault characteristic frequency, and search for the optimal parameters of the filter length roughly and accurately; lastly, the optimal MNAD algorithm combined with the Hilbert envelope spectrum is used for the fault diagnosis of rolling bearings. The feasibility of the method is proved in the simulation signals and experimental data.

Author Keywords: minimum noise amplitude inverse fold product

articleTitle: Initial Position Detection Strategy for PMSM Based on Improved Gradient Descent Algorithm and Elliptical Excitation Voltage Injection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The paper proposes an initial rotor position detection strategy for permanent magnet synchronous motors (PMSMs) based on high-frequency elliptical voltage injection. By analyzing the response current model of PMSM, the strategy utilizes the improved gradient descent algorithm to update and optimize the skew angle of the elliptical voltage, thereby analyzing the variation characteristics of the response current and obtaining the initial position of the rotor from it. Compared with traditional methods of initial rotor position detection, this strategy has a simpler structure, does not require specific motor parameters, and no longer relies on the cooperation of multiple filters to obtain positional information from the response current. It avoids the impact of filters on the current amplitude and reduces phase shifts caused by signal processing. The proposed initial rotor position detection strategy has been validated through simulation.

articleTitle: Hot Rolled Strip Deviation Detection Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Strip deviation is a major challenge in hot rolling production. It can cause significant economic losses and safety hazards. Accurate measurement of the deviation is further complicated by the rapid motion of the strip. To solve the problem, a YOLOv5 model is proposed in this study. The model combines the C3 module with the FasterNet architecture and the EMA mechanism to improve the recognition performance. In addition, a PFCA feature extraction module is proposed to enhance the extraction of feature information. Finally, a new loss function is adopted. The original model CIoU loss function is replaced by SIoU, and Inner-IoU is integrated into a new Inner-SIoU loss function. This adjustment facilitates network convergence and improves detection accuracy. Comparative experiments show that the model's mAP improves by 2.7% over the baseline network. The detection speed can reach 30 FPS to meet the real-time requirements.

articleTitle: Experimental Platform Design of Robotic Flexible Handling System with Vibration Suppression Function
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A robotic flexible handling experimental system composed of an industrial robot, an electromagnetic-drived connecting device, a suction cup and a workpiece is designed in this paper. The electromagnetic-drived connecting device is integrated with the suction cup and has the function of vibration suppression. The hardware and software of the experiment system are introduced, and the vibration control strategy based on PID controller is constructed. The robotic flexible handling experimental system prototype is developed and the robotic flexible handling experiment is carried out. The results show that the robotic flexible handling experimental system proposed has the function of vibration control, which can be used for the related scientific research and robot experiment teaching.

articleTitle: Research on Object Localization and Grasping of Collaborative Robotic Arm Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of difficult target localization and poor grasping accuracy of collaborative robotic arms in industrial application scenarios, a collaborative robotic arm target localization and grasping method based on ROS and deep learning is proposed. Firstly, an experimental platform is built, which consists of Kinectv2 vision system, Moveit control system and AUBOi5 robotic arm execution system; a target detection and recognition localization method to improve YOLOv8 lightweight model is designed based on Kinectv2 vision system to achieve target localization; GSConv and VoV-GSCSP network structure is used to change the feature Fusion Neck end to solve the problem of large number of parameters and high arithmetic requirements; experimental results show that the computational amount of the model improved GSConv and VoVGSCSP reduced by 6.9%, GFLOPs reduced by 9.8%; the success rate of the two target objects of screws and nuts fetching is 99% and 97%, respectively.

articleTitle: Active Disturbance Rejection Control Of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Speed Control System Based On Improved Fal Function
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the traditional active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) of permanent magnet synchronous motor (PMSM) speed loop, the fal function changes unsmoothly at the inflection point of the origin neighborhood, which causes high- frequency oscillation of the system output and large system gain when the error is large. An improved method of fal function in active disturbance rejection control is proposed, which makes the system gain gentle and continuous and derivable at the inflection point when the error is large. Based on this, an improved ADRC is designed to prove the stability of the improved ADRC in motor speed control. Finally, the research is simulated and analyzed. The analysis results show that the improved ADRC has better dynamic speed regulation performance than the traditional ADRC in the regulation of PMSM speed.

Author Keywords: permanent magnet synchronous motor speed control

articleTitle: Study on Model-Based Identification Method of Machining Part Fabrication Features
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To solve the difficulty of great error in detail part fabrication time estimation by means of man-hour, adapt to the module-based digital technology development and improve the accuracy of detail part fabrication time calculation, this article brings forward the module-based method for fabrication feature classification and identification, and establishes a set of rules for detail part fabrication feature identification to support the calculation of detail part fabrication time on the basis of fabrication features with the aid of the developed auxiliary software.

articleTitle: Overload Capability Design of MEMS Polycrystalline Silicon Nano-Diaphragm Pressure Sensors
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The pressure-sensing diaphragms of micro-electromechanical systems (MEMS) pressure sensors are prone to fracture under high pressure and eventually result in sensor performance failure. To address this issue, a technique is proposed in this study that can improve the overload capacity of MEMS polycrystalline silicon nano-diaphragm pressure sensors. A polycrystalline silicon diaphragm with a thickness of 80 nm is utilized for constructing the pressure-sensing diaphragm structure. Furthermore, the cavity height of the membrane for bottoming protection is analyzed using the static large deformation and contact nonlinear finite element analysis methods. Accordingly, the association of diaphragm sizes with sensor overload capacity is deduced, and the influence of diaphragm size variation on the overload capacity under different sensor ranges is discussed. The simulation results reveal that the MEMS polycrystalline silicon nanomembrane pressure sensor designed for a 1 MPa range exhibits an overload capacity of 8 MPa, which is eight times the sensor range. This study provides novel ideas that can contribute to the preparation of MEMS pressure sensors in real-time production.

articleTitle: Bi-level Optimization Scheduling of Source Load Storage in Park Grids Based on niche APSO Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Since a large amount of new energy generation is connected to the active distribution network, the volatility and randomness of photovoltaic and wind power pose great challenges to the economic and reliability of grid operation. Based on this background, with the objective of minimizing the comprehensive operating cost of the park level power grid, a bi-level optimization scheduling model for source load storage in the park level power grid was established, and an adaptive particle swarm optimization algorithm based on niche technology was proposed to solve the construction model. The simulation results show that the proposed model has better regional search ability and convergence speed, meeting the economic and reliability requirements of active distribution network operation.

articleTitle: Ship Attitude Prediction Based on VMD-PSO-LSTM
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The marine environment is full of complexity, which makes the ship's posture highly stochastic, Traditional prediction models are less effective in predicting ship attitude Therefore, Using variational modal decomposition (VMD) to preprocess ship attitude data can effectively reduce the complexity of ship signals and improve the prediction model with a particle swarm algorithm-optimized long-short time (PSO-LSTM) neural network. First, the ship posture data are decomposed into several intrinsic modal functions (IMFs) as well as residual terms using the VMD algorithm. Then, neural network hyperparameter optimization and model training are performed for Each IMF component and the residual term separately by PSO-LSTM model. Finally, the trained model is used to predict each of these decomposition terms, and the above predicted values are summed to obtain the prediction results. The results show that the root mean square error values of the model are reduced by 0.0407m and 0.0121m, and its mean absolute percentage error is reduced by 27.57% and 24.68% compared to the LSTM and PSO-LSTM models, respectively. The effectiveness of the method in improving the prediction accuracy is demonstrated.

Author Keywords: Long and short-term memory neural networks

articleTitle: Joint Optimization of Maintenance and Production Scheduling for Multi-component Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To address the impact of maintenance time during production scheduling processes and the impact of production scheduling on maintenance optimization, a joint modeling of maintenance and scheduling is proposed. Simultaneously, considering the interdependencies within multi-component systems, economic dependency is taken into account in maintenance optimization. For the joint model, a two-stage approach is introduced. In the first stage, deep reinforcement learning is employed for maintenance optimization considering production plans, with production information incorporated into the state space. In the second stage, maintenance strategies obtained from the first stage are utilized. Maintenance time and cost during production are considered in the optimization model, and genetic algorithm is used to solve the optimization problem.

articleTitle: A Multi-parameter Optimization Setting Method of Reactive Power Control for Fault Recovery Process of Doubly-Fed Wind Farm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: After the grid-connected system of doubly-fed wind farm fails, it typically undergoes the stages of fault period, fault removal and normal operation. At present, the related research primarily focuses on reactive power control (RPC) for low voltage ride-through (LVRT) of wind farms during the fault period. In fact, the problem of high voltage off-grid caused by transient overvoltage during wind power recovery after fault removal also needs attention. This paper provides a multi-parameter optimization setting method of RPC for the fault recovery process of doubly-fed wind farm. The implementation of RPC by this method can fully consider the limit capacity and response speed of different means such as rotor side converter (RSC), grid side converter (GSC) of doubly-fed induction generator (DFIG) and reactive power compensation device, and coordinate with the fault protection action of the transmission line of wind power system, and improve the voltage transient recovery trajectory of wind farm. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a multiple parallel doubly-fed wind farm test system.

articleTitle: Multi-objective Optimization Design for the Carcass of Marine Flexible Pipes Based on BP Neural Network and Particle Swarm Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The collapse of the carcass stands out as a primary mode of failure in marine flexible pipes. This paper delves into the multi-objective optimization design of the carcass layer’s structure, considering the thickness of steel strip and the height-thickness ratio of profile as design variables. Objective functions involve unit length weight and critical collapse value. The application of the BP neural network, combined with the multi-objective particle swarm optimization (MOPSO) algorithm, contributes to the optimization process. Additionally, the improved minimum distance selection method is employed to extract optimal results from the Pareto front. The conclusions derived from this paper can provide valuable insights for the design of carcass collapse resistance in engineering applications.

articleTitle: Thermal-stress-sag Coupling Power Flow Calculation and Safety Assessment of Overhead Line under Extreme High Temperature Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The frequent occurrence of extreme high temperature weather in summer results in a rapid increase in power grid load, heavy load or overload of power grid overhead lines or transmission channels, and poses significant challenges to the safe operation of the system. Therefore, this study investigates the relationship between high temperature meteorological conditions, conductor temperature, stress, and sag of overhead line. By incorporating the thermal-stress-sag coupling characteristic equation of overhead line into traditional power flow calculations, we enable the prediction of system power flow as well as line temperature, stress, and sag under extreme high temperature environments. Additionally, we establish safety overrun risk indexes for four types of lines to quantitatively evaluate the operational risks associated with thermal sag under extreme high temperature conditions. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by a modified IEEE39-bus power system.

articleTitle: Four-quadrant Key Circuit Design of Electric Vehicle Wireless Charging System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In view of the current problems in the field of wireless power transmission systems for electric vehicles, such as low charging efficiency, severe heating, slow charging speed, and strong high-frequency magnetic field radiation, in order to improve charging efficiency. Drawing on the design ideas of two-way wireless charging products for low-power appliances, a four-quadrant circuit suitable for electric vehicle wireless charging systems is proposed. The feasibility of the circuit is analyzed. The design ideas of the circuit are parameterized and how to implement it is given. Dynamic frequency tracking method.
