In addition to meeting the needs of wireless charging of electric vehicles, the research in this project can be extended to many fields such as medical equipment and even the military, and has broad application prospects.

articleTitle: Enhancing Temperature Adaptability for Airborne Equipment in Non-Pressurized Cabin: A Methodological Investigation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This study proposes a method to improve the temperature adaptability of aircraft equipment in non-pressurized cabin. The focus is on resolving issues related to Non-Low Temperature Resistant Components in the drag cone retractable system. The study aims to design a heating and thermal insulation method for the equipment in non-pressurized airplane cabin. To achieve precise temperature control, this study shows the feasibility of using heating cables as heating elements. The controllability of these cables at elevated temperatures is highlighted. The minimum power demand of the heating components is ascertained using the thermal simulation software ICEPAK. Additionally, an advanced control algorithm is developed that utilizes an improved BP neural network and a traditional PID combination. Extensive simulations in MATLAB/Simulink demonstrate that the combined control system outperforms traditional PID alone. Experimental validation confirms high efficacy of the proposed system in stabilizing equipment temperature within non-pressurized cabin, ensuring it operates consistently at optimal working temperatures. Consequently, this method proposed in this paper significantly enhances the environmental adaptability of equipment within the non-pressurized cabin of aircraft.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Forced Vibration of the Flexible Wheel of the Electromagnetic Harmonic Movable Tooth Transmission System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To achieve satisfactory dynamic performance of the electromagnetic harmonic active tooth transmission system, the frequency response of the forced vibration of the system is solved. Based on the consideration of the dynamic load component, the dynamic response of the system under the radial excitation is analyzed. In order to avoid the large vibration of each component, the influence law of structural parameters on the resonance amplitude of the system is discussed, research conclusion provides theoretical basis for system design.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Projectile Structure of Micro Electromagnetic Launcher Based on Scenarios
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As the core component of electromagnetic coil launcher, the projectile's structural parameters directly affect the launch performance of the system. At the same time, the special characteristics of the environment and targets in different application areas have different requirements for the structure of the projectile. In this paper, the projectile of the miniature electromagnetic launcher is taken as the research object, and the effects of multi-parameter coupling such as projectile mass, length-to-thickness ratio and inner diameter on the launching speed and launching efficiency are analyzed by using the finite element analysis software. Two new projectile structures for the ground and space environments are proposed. The simulation results show that when the projectile mass is fixed, the launch performance of the system increases with the increase of length-thickness ratio, and the optimal length-thickness ratio exists. The new structure for ground environment and the new structure for space environment can improve the launch performance by 14.5% and 5.3% respectively compared with the general structure, with better environmental reliability and applicability, which can provide reference for practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Fault Diagnosis Method for Power Transformers Based on Unbalanced Data Driving
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Oil immersed transformers may cause different faults due to long-term exposure to electrical thermal stress, posing a serious threat to the safe operation of the power system. In response to this issue, this study proposes a transformer fault diagnosis method based on dissolved gas analysis in oil and imbalanced data-driven analysis. Firstly, we choose four synthetic minority oversampling technique (SMOTE) algorithms to balance the imbalanced fault data. Secondly, this study combines base classifier decision trees (DT) and support vector machines (SVM), integrates classifiers AdaBoost and random forest (RF) algorithms for training and testing. Then, we compare and analyze four performance indicators of each scheme, including recognition accuracy P, recall R, F<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1-score</inf>, and computational time t. Finally, the results indicate that the SVM-SMOTE+AdaBoost scheme can effectively solve the problem of low overall fault diagnosis accuracy due to imbalanced raw data. Its various evaluation indicators have significantly improved, and the fault diagnosis accuracy has reached 95.7%. This method proposes new ideas and solutions for transformer fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Research on Narrow Gap GMAW Side Wall Fusion State Identification Based on Arc Sound Signal
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In modern manufacturing, Gas Metal Arc Welding (GMAW) is widely used for thick plate metal welding. However, due to the narrow space constraints of the weld seam, the automated detection and evaluation of sidewall fusion status present a challenging problem. To address this issue, this paper proposes a method for recognizing sidewall fusion status based on the extraction and processing of arc sound signal features. Firstly, the FAST ICA algorithm is utilized to separate ambient noise, reducing its interference with the analysis of arc sound signals. By extracting time-domain and frequency-domain features of arc sound signals under normal, critical fusion, and non-fusion welding conditions, this study explores the correlation between arc sound signals and welding quality. Introducing the Fisher criterion combined with the Recursive Feature Elimination method to determine the optimal feature subset, and using the K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) algorithm with 5-fold cross-validation to build a predictive model, an accuracy rate of 94.4% was achieved. This provides a new technical means for improving welding quality control and automation levels.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of a Python-based Software for High Field Magneto-Imaging System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Many scientific researches require the observation of microscopic images of samples under high magnetic fields. Due to the strong effect of high magnetic fields on magnetic materials and electronic devices, such microscopy imaging system is completely different from conventional systems. In order to control of the imaging system and the acquisition of microscopic image data under high magnetic fields, we developed a control software based on Python. This software provides functionalities such as monitoring the magnet status, controlling piezoelectric displacement devices, and real-time image monitoring. It further use an automatic focusing algorithm, in conjunction with piezoelectric displacement devices, to automatically focus optical images under high magnetic fields. Experimental results indicate that this software is capable of imaging samples under magnetic fields, thereby laying the foundation for the exploration of microscopic changes in samples under high magnetic field conditions.

articleTitle: A Novel MMC Circulation Suppression Control Strategy under Asymmetric Bridge Arm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Starting from the basic theory of Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC), this paper analyzes the basic structure of MMC and provides an analysis and explanation of the bridge arm circulating current and its suppression strategies. In practical applications, there is inevitably an asymmetry in the parameters of the upper and lower bridge arms of MMC, which makes the circulating current components more complex, with a DC component appearing in the circulation. Corresponding circulating current suppression strategies are proposed for both symmetric and asymmetric bridge arm situations, and simulation models have achieved good results in suppressing circulating currents.

articleTitle: Research on Flow Characteristics Optimization of Steam Turbine High-profile Valve Based on Piecewise Linear Representation Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to factors such as aging of through-flow structure, system modification and unit maintenance, the flow characteristics of high pressure regulating valve usually deviate from the design values to different degrees. This paper takes a 330MW sub-critical thermal power generation unit as an example. It calibrates the inherent regulating valve flow characteristics by non-overlap high pressure regulating valve switching stroke test, and optimizes the sequence valve flow characteristics by piecewise linear representation (PLR) algorithm. After the variable load test, the deviation of optimized flow characteristics linearity can be controlled within ±2%. It effectively improves the regulation quality of primary frequency regulation system, AGC system, and operating stability of units.

articleTitle: Research on DC Pantograph-Catenary Arc Recognition Method Based on PIO-LVQ
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: DC power supply is the primary power supply method for subway trains. However, DC pantograph-catenary arcs can damage the slide plate, shorten the service life of the pantograph, and even endanger the entire system. In this paper, a DC pantograph-catenary arc experimental platform is established to conduct pantograph-catenary arc experiments under different conditions of current level, voltage level, and operating speed. By analyzing the current signals, the DC arc faults of the pantograph-catenary are identified. The variational mode decomposition (VMD) is employed to process the current signals, and a pigeon-inspired optimization (PIO) algorithm is used to optimize the learning vector quantization neural network (LVQ) for fault arc diagnosis, known as the PIO-LVQ model. The mean value of the current signal, VMD energy entropy, and sample entropy are taken as feature inputs into the model for training and testing its fault detection accuracy. Comparative experiments with LVQ, probabilistic neural networks (PNN), and generalized regression neural networks (GRNN) demonstrate that the proposed method achieves higher accuracy in detecting DC pantograph-catenary arcs.

articleTitle: Asychronous Controller Design for Markov Jump interconnected Systems with Output Quantization
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In this paper, decentralized asynchronous output feedback controllers is proposed for Markov jump interconnected systems with general bounded transition rates. The designed asynchronous output feedback controllers are independent of the system mode, which means that it has sustainable control behavior for the unavailable systems mode. In the controller design, the small-gain condition and the Shure compensation are used to deal with unknown interconnections and nonlinear problem. In addition, the existing conditions of the controller are obtained by using linear matrix inequalities. Finally, a simulation is given to verify the feasibility of the controller.

articleTitle: Decentralised Event-Triggered Control of Multi-Agent Systems over Antagonistic Interactions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper studies the asynchronous decentralised bipartite consensus for multi-agent systems over antagonistic interactions using an event-triggered algorithm. A distributed nonlinear protocol is constructed to achieve bipartite consensus. Specially, when the antagonistic networks meet condition of structurally balanced, all agents reach an agreement characterized by an identical amplitude but opposite signs with dependence on the link weights. Moreover, using event-triggered strategies to reduce cost in communication and computation, a controller that is only updated at triggered instants determined by local information, is proposed. Note that bipartite consensus is implemented in enlarged sampling periods with absences of Zeno behaviour. Numerical results illustrate the effectiveness of the theoretical models.

articleTitle: Design of Tunneling Magnetoresistive Effect Current Sensor for Power Cable Sheath Current Measurement
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Sheath current has been a crucial indicator for power cable diagnosis. Conventionally, current transformers were used to the measure the sheath currents. However, the sensitivity and bandwidth of the current transformers were generally limited. This research presents the design of a tunneling magnetoresistance (TMR) effect current sensor for sheath current measurement. A simulation model of the power cable link box was built to evaluate the parameters of the TMR device. A signal conditioning circuit was built to modify the raw outputs of the TMR device. Furthermore, we built a testing platform to verify the performance of the designed sensor. The results indicate that the TMR effect current sensor can accurately measure sheath currents up to 200 A<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">R.M.S.</inf> with a relative error margin of 1%. The sensor also showed a flat response up to 10 kHz. We also verified the designed TMR effect current sensors by measuring the sheath currents in a cable termination box at a substation in Shanghai.

articleTitle: Design of Mecannum Wheel-based Intelligent Stacking AGV Using Kalman Filtering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: An intelligent stacking AGV (Automated Guided Vehicle) is proposes for the intelligent handling and stacking requirements of smart factories. The AGV achieves positioning and navigation through a TOF laser ranging sensor and a gyro sensor, where the TOF laser ranging sensor is used to measure distance values and the gyro sensor is used to obtain yaw angle values. In order to achieve the accuracy and real-time of robot laser global positioning, this paper proposes a method based on the combination of Kalman filter and incremental PID algorithm, so that the robot can predict the robot position recursively through the distance information measured by TOF laser rangefinder, which effectively improves the accuracy of robot positioning and realizes the global positioning of stacking robot. The experiments and simulations were conducted on this intelligent stacking AGV. The experimental and simulation results verify the stability and reliability of the AGV in both dynamic and static environments, enabling accurate and fast completion of material stacking operations. This enables the intelligent stacking AGV to meet the requirements of high efficiency, high accuracy, and high reliability in smart factories.

articleTitle: Simulation Study on Postoperative Soft Robot for Moving
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: After medical surgery, patient handling is a very important process. Manual handling not only requires manual labor, but also makes patients feel uncomfortable during the handling process. If the handling method is not correct, it is easy to cause secondary damage to the patient. To address these issues, this paper, based on the established structure of soft actuators, determines the arrangement of soft actuators for transport and simulates the transport process of soft actuators. The results indicate that the average acceleration of the wooden board during forward movement is -32.5 m/s every 4 seconds, with an average maximum velocity of -150 m/s, ensuring sufficient power during the forward movement of the wooden board. The transport process consists of 11 complete cycles, taking a total of 13.2 seconds, validating the feasibility of the soft actuator group for transport.

articleTitle: Design of a Compact Rotational Compliant Stage with Two-stage Lever Amplification Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Rotational stages with high-accuracy positioning performance are a key component to deal with the errors of array alignment in industries. In this paper, a new compliant mechanism is developed to perform the task of rotational motion output, where a two-stage lever amplification mechanism is designed to have a compact design. Then, the compliant mechanism is kinematically analyzed and the compliance model of the second lever mechanism is established. Based on the model, the dimensions are optimized to have a pure rotational motion output. Finally, the whole design is simulated and evaluated in association with COMSOL. The results show that the proposed design can output a 0.79 mrad motion with a 9-µm displacement input of the actuator, and the first-order natural frequency is determined as 2219 Hz, which confirms the compact design.

articleTitle: Development of Robotic Arm Grasping Experimental Platform Based on Gesture Guidance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the advancement of science and technology, robotic arms are increasingly used in industrial production and teaching, and their use of remote operation is also an important research branch of robotic arms. At the same time, with the development of machine vision and deep learning in recent years, a series of gesture recognition algorithms and frameworks have emerged. This paper combines gesture recognition with robotic arm control, and uses rapid control prototyping technology to propose a control method that uses gestures to guide the movement of the robotic arm.

articleTitle: Sensorless Control Strategy of Switched Reluctance Motor Based on Inductance Decrease Region
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Conventional sensorless control methods for switched reluctance motors (SRMs) often do not take into account the impact of electromagnetic saturation. This can lead to errors in rotor estimation, particularly under heavy load conditions. An inductance decrease region-based sensorless control method for SRM is proposed in this research to address this issue. The initial location of the rotor at rest is determined by the inductance comparison method, which also yields the initial torque. Next, a mathematical model for the inductance and angle of SRM is derived using the Fourier series. Finally, the inductance decrease region method is proposed to avoid the effect of electromagnetic saturation. The rotor angle is determined by applying the inverse trigonometric function, which then allows for the computation of the motor's speed. The simulation results demonstrate that the method can precisely and seamlessly estimate the position and speed of the rotor, thereby greatly enhancing the performance of sensorless control.

articleTitle: Research on Path Planning of Inspection Robots for Epidemic Prevention
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the face of the severe shortage of healthcare professionals required to deliver high-quality medical care to all patients during an epidemic, intelligent robots can be deployed in healthcare facilities for tasks such as material handling, distribution, and sterilization. This paper focuses on utilizing automated guided vehicles (AGVs) for indoor inspection and sterilization tasks to alleviate the critical scarcity of health workers. A differential evolution-based artificial potential field algorithm (DE-APF) is proposed to optimize the motion trajectory of autonomous guidance. The experiments observed AGV motion trajectories and identified that excessive attraction towards target points resulted in collisions with indoor obstacles. Furthermore, during the optimization process, a problem was encountered where AGVs experienced zero combined force, hindering path exploration and leading to local minima. Compared with the Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) and the Rapid Exploration Random Tree (RRT) algorithm, the DE-APF algorithm improves the results by 14.28% at 10 target points; 7.5% and 9.26% improvement at 20 target points. The improved algorithm reduces the path length while the safe distance from obstacles is guaranteed.

articleTitle: Optimization of Active Disturbance Rejection Control Parameters for Spacecraft Docking in Approach Phase
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The spacecraft docking in approach phase positional attitude coupling control problem is a key technology for engineering applications in the space field. With regard to the performance indexes of error accuracy, robustness and energy consumption of the self-resilient control, the paper selects a suitable fitness function according to the ITAE principle, and incorporates the concept of chaos on the basis of particle swarm algorithm, and realizes the global optimization of the performance indexes by utilizing the diversity and ergodicity of the chaotic variable characteristics. The concept of chaos is added to the particle swarm algorithm, and the diversity of chaotic variables and traversal characteristics are utilized to achieve the global optimization of performance indexes. The simulation results show that the approximate segment ADRC system with control parameters selected by CPSO algorithm has better dynamic performance and tracking accuracy.

articleTitle: Improving the Insulator and Self-Explosion Detection Algorithm of YOLOv5s
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: At present, deep learning models are developing rapidly, but there is still room for improvement in the accuracy of insulator detection in complex backgrounds. This article improves the YOLOv5s detection algorithm, improved Backbone for target features, and reduces the loss of feature information in the convolution process of small targets; Drawing on the weighting idea in BiFPN, the input weighting of Concat in Neck is processed, and weights are assigned based on the correlation strength of feature information; Finally, in order to further reduce model parameters and ensure that the detection performance of the model remains basically unchanged, GhostConv is introduced to achieve the lightweight effect of the model. The experimental results show that the improved YOLOv5 increases the mAP value to 1.9% compared to the original model, reduces computational complexity by 3.1G, and reduces model volume by 7.6mb.

articleTitle: Application of Improved SA-GA-BP in Structural Optimization of Expansion Device
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The basic requirements for the expansion devices of highway bridges have been determined in the Bridge and Structural Engineering Conference, one of which is the noise reduction and vibration reduction. Our country's expansion device needs to be innovated based on this. In order to study the impact of a new bridge expansion device structure on noise and optimize its structure, the max A-weighted sound pressure level (SPLA) was taken as the optimization target. First, 60 groups of test points were selected using Latin hypercube sampling (LHS), and the model was reconstructed. Then, the finite element method (FEM) was combined with boundary element method (BEM) to simulate the vehicle driving through the expansion device to obtain the far-field max SPLA. A novel BP neural network based on genetic algorithm (GA) and simulated annealing (SA) algorithm optimization is proposed to solve the BP neural network's susceptibility to random initial weights, threshold interference and GA easy to fall into premature. Then, training improved BP neural network to obtain the relationship between structural parameters and the max SPLA. Subsequently, the orthogonal experimental design (OED) method is used to design test points and predict their max SPLA to determine the optimal structure. The results show that the optimized expansion device reduces the max SPLA of the original structure by 12.27dBA, and the optimization rate reaches 13.07%. This research method can provide theoretical guidance for structural optimization of bridge expansion devices, has practical engineering significance, and the results are reliable.

articleTitle: Non-smooth Dynamics Analysis of a Variable Topology Mechanism with Two Topologies
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The non-smooth excitation caused by the topology change of the flexible variable topology mechanism may have a great influence on the flexible component amplitude. In view of this, this paper studies the non-smooth dynamics characteristics of a folding manipulator belonging to the flexible variable topology mechanism. The vibration response model of the flexible beam under different topologies and the non-smooth dynamics model at topology change are established. On this basis, the numerical simulations are developed. The variation of the amplitude of the flexible beam under the different rigid rod rotation speeds and different initial positions of the object is investigated. Through the bifurcation diagram, time domain diagram and phase diagram, it demonstrate that the flexible beam amplitude may diverge under the non-smooth external excitation caused by the periodic topology change. Finally, the design criteria of the folding manipulator motion process are proposed through the simulation results.

articleTitle: Electronic IoT Technology and Cloud Computing in Intelligent Manufacturing Industry
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Traditional research is often limited to the independent application of electronic Internet of Things (IoT) technology or cloud computing, and lacks integration research between the two, resulting in certain limitations in collaboration and efficiency when applied in the intelligent manufacturing industry. This article combines electronic IoT technology and cloud computing, using intelligent algorithms to promote the synergy of various technologies in the intelligent manufacturing industry and improve production efficiency. Collecting large-scale intelligent manufacturing data through sensors, this article would store the collected data on cloud platforms and preprocess it. It intelligently analyzes intelligent manufacturing data through an improved Long Short Term Memory (LSTM) model. The directions for improving LSTM models include introducing attention mechanisms and Dropout regularization techniques. The results show that the average output input ratios of traditional manufacturing enterprises and intelligent manufacturing enterprises are 1.35 and 3.87, respectively. Therefore, the application of electronic IoT technology and cloud computing can effectively improve the production efficiency of intelligent manufacturing.

articleTitle: A Method for Adjusting the Resistance Size in a Negative Feedback Circuit Through Process
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Feedback circuit can improve the stability of the gain, reduce the non-linear distortion, widen the passband of the amplifier, and affect the input and output resistance of the amplifier. In the actual production, in order to ensure that the wafer realizes the specified output function, methods and measures are adopted in the preparation process to control the product characteristics. This paper discusses the control of transistor magnification and the adjustment of resistance in triode, and how to ensure the final withstand voltage of products.

Author Keywords: Resistance Adjustment Method of Feedback Circuit

articleTitle: Finite Element Analysis and Experimental Validation of 72000kN Vibration Isolation Device Testing System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to improve the quality of bearing testing and promote the improvement of bearing quality, this paper carries out finite element analysis and experimental verification for the self-developed 72000kN vibration isolation device testing system. Firstly, the structural composition and technical parameters of the system are introduced, and the whole structure modeling and simulation technology of the dynamic compression-shear experimental machine under large two-dimensional load and large displacement and the topology optimization of key parts are studied by ANSYS finite element analysis software. Then it is concluded that the overall structure of the system meets the stiffness requirements, the normal operation of the conclusion will not resonate. Finally, the measured experiments: the maximum stress of the main frame of the compression shear testing machine during operation is 11.62MPa, the maximum deformation is 5.312mm, which are relatively consistent with the simulation results and within a reasonable range. Verified that the system loading process is smooth and reliable, and the system function is normal.

Author Keywords: dynamic compression and shear experimental machine

articleTitle: Modeling and Simulation Design of Single Crystal Silicon Growth by Czochralski Method
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Due to difficulties in observing crystal state and the high cost of crystal preparation, the teaching of the Czochralski single crystal silicon production is complex. To solve the above problem, a digital twins-inspired virtual simulation system for the growth of single crystal silicon was developed. The 3D models of the single crystal furnace, single crystal silicon rods, and other related objects were created using Blender. The nonlinear model of the single crystal silicon growth process was established based on the heat conduction during crystal growth and geometric deformation. The 3D models were then imported into the web page using Three.js. The PID control algorithm was used to control the temperature and pulling speed, and finally, the B/S architecture was adopted to design and implement the virtual simulation experiment system for the growth of Czochralski single crystal silicon. The virtual simulation method will help to overcome the shortcomings of on-site experiment teaching and enhance students’ understanding of the entire single crystal silicon preparation process.

articleTitle: A Compound Virtual Synchronous Machine Strategy for Low Voltage Ride Through
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The virtual synchronous machine technology can mitigate various stability risks stemming from the reduced proportion of synchronous machines. Employing a composite control method based on positive and negative sequence separation enables smooth transition of currents during faults. However, the introduction of delays in the positive and negative sequence components affects the reaction speed of the VSM after fault clearance, posing a risk of overcurrent. Utilizing virtual impedance for low voltage ride through can effectively limit current flow. Nonetheless, excessive virtual resistance increases the output impedance of the VSM, while virtual reactance worsens its control performance. To address this issue, a compound low voltage ride-through strategy for VSMs is proposed. This strategy introduces time-varying virtual impedance based on the composite control strategy of positive and negative sequence VSMs. It aims to mitigate the risk of weak overcurrent associated with positive and negative sequence separation while minimizing the negative effects of virtual impedance. The effectiveness of the proposed method is validated using Power Factory software.

articleTitle: Motion Simulation and Optimization of LED Chip Scanning and Positioning Based on NX MCD
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The current LED chip scanning and positioning experiments heavily rely on physical testing equipment, demanding significant time and resources for device calibration. Moreover, the validation tests are prone to damaging the chips and tools, leading to unnecessary resource wastage. As a result, this paper adopts virtual debugging technology by using NX software to establish the LED chip detection machine's model and properties. It involves programming scan and point measurement procedures through TIA Portal software, and incorporates MCD cameras and visual software for template matching and positioning. Within the simulation environment, the paper performs motion simulation of redundant strategies for LED chip scanning and validates optimization methods to improve deduplication accuracy by 0.3%. This approach effectively minimizes the risks and resource consumption in actual experiments, while fostering the development of automation in chip visual positioning.

articleTitle: Forming technology and finite element analysis of continuous flexible anti-seepage wall
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Compared to the plastic concrete cutoff wall, the polymer cutoff wall offers benefits such as improved seismic performance, environmental friendliness, and durability. However, existing technology and equipment are difficult to ensure the continuity of trenching and grouting in deep and narrow flexible wall. In order to address the problem, this paper proposes a novel technology and equipment for simultaneous excavation and grouting, which combines vertical chainsaw trenching with intermittent grouting. And the detailed construction process of this technology is presented. The finite element method is employed to analyze the interaction between the single tool and the soil in the vertical direction. Following the cutting process, the formation of uniform grooves and flat walls demonstrates the feasibility of chainsaw groove trenching. Additionally, the finite element method is employed to simulate the formation of the film using a single nozzle and the subsequent expansion of the liquid film. It is observed that the film formation is uniform and the expansion is continuous and controllable, which proves the feasibility of intermittent spraying. The results showed that the construction technology and equipment involving chainsaw trenching and intermittent grouting can address the continuity issues in excavation and grouting.

articleTitle: Construction of an Intelligent Fault Identification System for Power Grid under Adaptive Genetic Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The increasingly complex structure of the power grid, as well as the integration of new energy and distributed generation resources, have led to a more diverse variety of types and modes of power grid faults. This study proposes an intelligent identification method for power grid faults based on the principle of Adaptive Genetic Algorithm (AGA). Firstly, it collects fault data through power grid monitoring equipment. Then, through an encoding scheme, these parameters are transformed into chromosomes that can be processed by genetic algorithms. In the design of the fitness function, the accuracy and real-time performance of fault detection are considered to ensure that the algorithm can effectively evaluate the quality of chromosomes. The control parameters of the genetic algorithm based on the performance of the process to enhance the convergence and robustness of the algorithm can be dynamically adjusted. Through comparative testing on multiple power grid fault data, the results show that the AGA based intelligent identification system for power grid faults is superior to traditional genetic algorithms (GA) and artificial neural networks (ANN) in terms of fitness function, convergence accuracy, and interpretability. Its fitness value can reach 96%, with a minimum relative error of 0.8% and an interpretability of 88%. This system can effectively process power grid fault data and provide a new intelligent tool for power grid operation and maintenance. Future work can focus on further optimizing the performance of AGA and achieving its widespread application.

Author Keywords: Intelligent Identification of Power Grid Faults

articleTitle: Research on the Siting Selection Problem of Preposition Warehouse Based on Uncertainty Theory
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Conventional warehouses generate a lot of carbon emissions in addition to having long delivery times, long transportation distances, and poor transportation efficiency. The preposition warehouse provides a reasonable solution to the above-mentioned problems. This work applies uncertainty programming to the warehouse's minimum total cost function and minimum customer discontent function, which helps to construct the site selection model for the warehouse. And the northwest area of Jinan City, Shandong Province, is used as an example for numerical experiments. Then, combine the weights of the optimal solutions found under the dual objectives using the linear weighted sum method to find the effective solutions, which will help identify appropriate pre-warehouse construction points.

articleTitle: Study of Current Prediction Control for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors with Parameter Mismatch Consideration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Regarding high-performance servo control methods for permanent magnet synchronous motors, current prediction control strategy can reduce the ripple of system current loop. To address the issue of current prediction error resulting from parameter mismatch in the predictive model, this paper proposes a two-step current prediction control strategy considering parameter mismatch. This strategy not only accurately and rapidly identifies motor parameters to enhance system parameter robustness but also optimizes current control precision and reduces the impact of sampling and computation delays in the control system. The proposed method is validated for feasibility and effectiveness through simulations.

articleTitle: High-speed Elevator Car Full-Band Noise Prediction Method Based on FEM-BEM and SEA
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: High-speed elevator produces aerodynamic noise ranging from tens to thousands of hertz. Different noise prediction methods have different applicability ranges, and no single numerical method can predict full-band noise. To enable complete vibroacoustic prediction, this paper proposes a method that combines finite-element-boundary-element method (FEM-BEM) and statistical energy analysis (SEA). The FEM-BEM model predicts low frequency noise using structural and aerodynamic noise excitation, while the SEA model predicts medium-high frequency noise using convective and acoustic components of aerodynamic noise. The experimental and simulated noise values tend to be consistent in the whole frequency band, and the total sound pressure level error is 9.3%. The error is within the allowable range of engineering application, which validates the accuracy and applicability of the proposed method. This suggests directions for future optimization and improvement.

Author Keywords: Prediction of noise in elevator car

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Rogowski Coil with Pulse Compound Integrator
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper describes a Rogowski coil integrator for pulsed high current measurements. Based on the principle and equivalent model of Rogowski coil, this paper designs an impulse composite integrator that is compatible with the coil sensitivity, bandwidth and phase by comparing the shortcomings of the first-order RC integrator and the classical active integrator at the design stage. The integrator consists of a passive part and an active part. The passive part is used for mid-frequency integration, which reduces the gain of the coil. The active part is used for low-frequency integration, which has a lifting effect on the system gain. In addition to this, the overall sensitivity can be changed by adjusting the gain coefficient between the frequency band of the passive integrator and the active integrator. Finally, the circuit simulation was carried out using MULTISIM to verify the effectiveness of the integrator design.

articleTitle: Optimization and Simulation of Roller Leveler Frame
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In response to the phenomena of shaking and unstable straightening accuracy during the straightening process of the roller leveler, the reasons were analyzed, and a static analysis of the roller leveler frame was conducted with ANSYS Workbench. According to the finite element analysis results, the TRIZ technical contradiction analysis method was used to optimize the design of the frame, and the optimization schemes were analyzed again with ANSYS Workbench to determine the best one.During the process, the combination of TRIZ technology contradiction analysis method and finite element analysis effectively improves the safety and stability of the frame, better ensures the accuracy of part straightening, shortens the design cycle, and reduces design costs.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Selection of Hydraulic Support for Gently Inclined Comprehensive Mining Face Based on PSO-BP Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As an important part of coal mining mechanization, the reliability of hydraulic support is an important guarantee for the hydraulic support system of the comprehensive mining face, and the fast, accurate, and intelligent selection of hydraulic support determines its reliability. To realize the intelligent selection of hydraulic support for the slow inclined comprehensive mining face, and to improve the efficiency and accuracy of the selection of the hydraulic support, a hydraulic support selection method based on the PSO-BP neural network is proposed in this paper. A relationship model between geological parameters and hydraulic support technical parameters is established, and the model is trained by using hydraulic support selection case data as samples. Based on the training results, the model can be used to input new geological parameters to intelligently recommend the selection plan of hydraulic support technical parameters. The actual selection scheme of a coal mine is analyzed as a case study, and the results are compared with the traditional BP neural network selection results. The results indicate that the PSO-BP neural network can efficiently generate the hydraulic support technical parameter selection program. It outperforms the traditional BP neural network in terms of computational accuracy and convergence speed. This provides a reliable reference for intelligent hydraulic support selection.

articleTitle: Research and Application of Numerical Batching and Mixing Equipment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The technical application of numerical batching and mixing equipment is studied. Adopt mechatronic-hydraulic integration scheme, Combined with motor driven hydraulic technology, load-sensitive hydraulic pump technology, load- sensitive proportional directional valve technology, programmable logic controller technology, Modbus RTU communication technology, HMI human-computer interaction technology, coupling torque transmission technology, centrifugal pump hydraulic transmission technology, Venturi negative pressure jet technology, spiral stirring transportation technology, stirring mixing technology, etc. Through the analysis of the action and functional requirements of the batching mixing equipment, design, calculation and selection are carried out to form a complete set of mechanical transmission, hydraulic drive structure, electrical power supply and control logic to realize the action and functions of the batching mixing equipment. Through the technical application of batching mixing equipment, a set of mechatronic hydraulic integrated equipment which can be controlled by touch screen, read batching mixing parameters in real time, and perform logic algorithm to make judgment execution is developed, which provides certain guiding significance for the application of modern batching mixing equipment.

articleTitle: Reinforcement Learning based Anti-UAV Three-dimensional Pursuit-evasion Game for Substation Security
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The illegal intrusion of unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) into substations will have a serious impact on the safe operation of the power grid. This article will adopt the method of equipping UAV in the substation system to capture illegal UAV. Specifically, the pursuit-evasion game of UAV will be transformed into solving the Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation using the principle of differential games, and then the integral reinforcement learning algorithm will be used to solve the pursuit-evasion game problem. Finally, the simulation results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed algorithm in the UAV pursuit-evasion game problem.

articleTitle: Application of Laser Ultrasonic Detection Technology in Thin Metal Plate Weld Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The butt weld of thin metal plate is widely used in the manufacture of packaging barrels for low and intermediate level radioactive waste. This paper introduces the application of a direct laser ultrasonic detection technology in butt weld detection of thin metal plate. Through experimental research, the related detection technology parameters are obtained, and the advantages and limitations of this technology in weld detection of waste barrels are summarized. Meanwhile, it provides experimental basis and ideas for the application of laser ultrasonic in nondestructive detection of butt weld of thin metal plate.

articleTitle: Research on Manipulator Controlling based on Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the development of robotics, robotic arms are becoming more and more widely used in industrial production, service industries and daily life. However, the traditional robotic arm control method has limitations in the face of complex environments and tasks, and how to achieve efficient control of the robotic arm has become one of the current research hotspots. Based on deep reinforcement learning, this study proposes a robotic arm control framework based on the strategy gradient method. Initially, we designed an end-to-end neural network model to learn the strategy of the robotic arm to select the optimal action in different states. The neural network model utilizes a convolutional neural network to efficiently process the visual input and continuous action space of the robotic arm. Subsequently, we use a deep deterministic strategy gradient algorithm to train the model, and continuously update the neural network parameters by interacting with the environment, so that the robotic arm can gradually improve its performance when performing tasks. Through experimental validation in a simulated environment and on a real robotic arm platform, our method has achieved significant performance improvements across multiple tasks.

articleTitle: Design and Optimization for Three-Degree-of-Freedom Vibration Systems with Viscous Damping
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Vibration isolation systems can be classified into single-degree-of-freedom systems, two-degree-of-freedom systems, and multi-degree-of-freedom systems by degree of freedom. Many scholars have conducted extensive researches on single-degree-of-freedom and two-degree-of-freedom systems, but few on three-degree-of-freedom systems. In this paper, a mechanical model was established for a three-degree-of-freedom vibration system with viscous damping, through which a force transmissibility equation was derived using an impedance method, then asymptotic expressions of force transmissibility were given for both low-frequency and high-frequency regions, and finally an optimization design method for three-degree-of-freedom systems was derived under the constraints of equipment displacement and a sum of intermediate masses. In order to minimize the force transmissibility in the high-frequency region, the isolators and intermediate masses should be designed following the equal-rigidity and equal-mass principle under the premise of not exceeding the allowable equipment displacement and the total mass.

articleTitle: Leakage Verification and Analysis of the Fluid Swivel of the Single-Point Mooring System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In this paper, the basic principle of the fluid swivel is introduced, and the domestic slip ring of "Nanhai Endeavor" FPSO is taken as the research object. Firstly, the design data of the fluid swivel were summarized, and then the leakage check analysis of the outlet flange was carried out to verify the rationality of the structure. Then, the flow field of the rotating cavity is calculated, the cross-section shape of the rotating cavity is optimized, and finally the pressure loss after optimizing the cross-section of the rotating cavity is calculated. The above work is of great significance for the localization of single-point mooring fluid swivel.

articleTitle: Research on the Energy Harvesting Coefficient and Near Wake Flow of a Dual Vertical Axis Wave Current Coupled Power Generation System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This article takes the outline of the sailfish as an airfoil profile and establishes a dual vertical axis water turbine model. The centrifugal and axial flow water turbines share a common drive shaft, which is connected to the generator. The centrifugal water turbine utilizes tidal energy, while the axial flow water turbine utilizes wave potential energy. Based on Fluent UDF and sliding grid, numerical simulation of hydraulic turbines was conducted, and it was found that the centrifugal turbine had the highest energy harvesting coefficient at an attack angle of 25 °, while the axial flow turbine had the highest energy harvesting coefficient at an attack angle of 35 °. The centrifugal turbine has the highest energy gain when the tip speed ratio is 1.25 and the Reynolds number is 1.3e ^ 5. The axial flow turbine has the highest energy gain when the tip speed ratio is 1.5 and the Reynolds number is 5.5e ^ 4. The downstream turbine impeller utilizes the Kantar effect to perform work, but the boundary layer separation is severe and vortex shedding is obvious, which seriously affects the energy harvesting efficiency of the turbine.

articleTitle: Intelligent Intake and Fuel Constant Temperature System for Mine
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to solve the problem that the explosion proof diesel engine for mine can not start normally in high cold environment, or the intake and fuel can not reach a good premixed temperature after driving, which leads to lack of power and alack smoke of flame-proof diesel engine. Based on electrical control technology and MT 990-2006 “general technical conditions for mine explosion proof diesel engine”, an intelligent intake and fuel constant temperature system for explosion proof diesel engine is designed, and bench test of flame-proof diesel engine and vehicle cold test are carried out. The test results show that the intelligent intake and fuel constant temperature system can effectively improve the cold start performance, dynamic performance, fuel economy and emission performance of the vehicle in high cold environment, effectively reduce the complexity of vehicle maintenance in alpine environment, and improve the applicability of explosion proof diesel vehicles.

Author Keywords: intelligent intake and fuel constant temperature system

articleTitle: Research on Force/Position Hybrid Control Method for Cooperative Polishing of Dual Robots Based on Adaptive Impedance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The collaboration of industrial robots in multiple-machine settings enhances adaptability for complex component machining. This paper focuses on a cooperative polishing system composed of two industrial robots. Addressing the challenge of maintaining a constant polishing force on the surface of a hub, we propose a dual robot cooperative polishing force/position hybrid control method based on an adaptive impedance control strategy. Recognizing the significant steady-state error in force tracking under unknown environmental changes in traditional impedance control, our approach involves the real-time adjustment of impedance parameters by adapting to variations in environmental stiffness, position, and other factors. This enables accurate and stable tracking of the desired polishing force. Simulation results validate the robustness of the proposed control algorithm against environmental changes. Additionally, practical experiments on dual robot cooperative polishing force control confirm that the adaptive impedance control strategy efficiently tracks the desired force, enhancing both polishing efficiency and quality.

articleTitle: Model Predictive Current Control of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Linear Motor Based on Sliding Mode Observer
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to achieve more accurate control of permanent magnet synchronous linear motor (PMSLM) drive system, a sensorless control strategy of three-vector model predictive current control (TV-MPCC) + sliding mode observer (SMO) is proposed. First, the TV-MPCC is used instead of the traditional vector control method to improve the controllable range, reduce the number of predictions, and improve the control efficiency. Second, a sliding mode observer is utilized to estimate the system electromotive force and a phase-locked loop strategy is used instead of an inverse tangent function to infer the desired information in order to avoid the error phase delay and phase compensation process. Simulation results show that the proposed method satisfies the system operating requirements.

articleTitle: Fast-response and Broadband Laser Detector Based on the transverse Thermoelectric Effect
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The laser detector based on the transverse thermoelectric (TTE) effect is an effective means to detect laser parameters, including laser power/energy, frequency, duration, and shape. However, poor sensitivity restricts its application. Here, we first prepare the laser detector composed of inclined YBa<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>Cu<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>O<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7-δ</inf> (YBCO) thin film, which exhibits fast and broadband response characteristics. it can well track the 300 kHz 900 nm laser. Under the irradiation of a 248 nm laser with a duration of 28 ns and a 532 nm laser with a duration of 9 ns, the response times τ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">d</inf> of the detector are 56 ns and 48 ns, respectively. Then, To solve the problem of low sensitivity, we propose a multi-line structure. The experimental results show that the multi-line structure can effectively enhance the response voltage without changing the size of the detector. In future work, the multi-line structure can be combined with the MEMS manufacturing process to achieve high sensitivity and small-size laser detectors for accurate detection of laser beam spot distribution.

articleTitle: Trusted Power Load Management Communication Framework Using Topology Clustering and Blockchain Authentication
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel communication framework for a new type of power load management system, utilizing a geographic clustering approach based on the K-means algorithm to optimize network topology. Each cluster of communication nodes forms a subnet, with the cluster center serving as a routing node. Leveraging blockchain principles, each subnet is structured as a circular blockchain, starting with the routing node as the genesis block. This node initializes communication with a timestamp and computes the hash of the block, passing it to the next node. Subsequent nodes add their data and timestamps to the previous hash, computing new hashes and continuing the chain. The last node in the subnet links back to the routing node, forming a closed loop, which enables the routing node to validate the integrity of the entire subnet’s data. The same validation mechanism is extended between the routing nodes and the main station of the power load management system, ensuring robust and trustworthy communication across the network. This dual verification mechanism enhances the reliability and security of data transmission within the power load management system.

articleTitle: Nonlinear Identification of Double-Bolt Connected Beams Based on the Valanis Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In mechanical connection structures, bolted connections are commonly used. This article primarily investigates the nonlinear dynamic behavior, modeling, and parameter identification of multi-bolted beam connections. The research focuses on the connections at both ends of the beam and the bolted connections, analyzing their dynamic behavior under external excitation. The Valanis model will be used to simulate the nonlinear responses at these two locations. Various excitation forces of different magnitudes will be applied to the bolted beam during experiments. The data obtained from high excitation tests will be utilized to determine the parameters of the Valanis model, while the data from low excitation tests will be used to identify the material parameters of the beam. Optimization techniques will primarily be used to minimize the error between experimental and simulation data, thus achieving the identification goals.

articleTitle: Analysis Method of Power Factor Fluctuation Based on Phase Compound Generator
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In China's warship design, the phase compound excitation generator occupies a large proportion as its power source. The fluctuation of power factor has a great influence on the power quality and efficiency of the generator, and also affects the accuracy of the instruments on board. An effective solution is put forward to eliminate the fault quickly to ensure the normal use of equipment and ship sailing rate. Therefore, the mathematical model of the phase compound generator is first established in this paper. In the process of generator use, aiming at the power factor fluctuation problem of a certain type of phase compound excitation generator, a systematic and comprehensive analysis idea is put forward by introducing the magnetic system of this type of phase compound excitation system, and the idea is tested and verified by a real ship, which solves the fluctuation problem.

articleTitle: Research on Valves Fault Detection Method Based on Characteristic Parameters
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Electric gate valves play a key role in industrial control, however, due to the influence of long-term operation and harsh environment, they may face various faults, which directly affect the reliability of the system. To this end, the purpose of this experiment is to deeply study the performance of electric gate valves under different working conditions through fault simulation experiments and data acquisition. The experiment covers a detailed introduction of the electric gate valves device, fault simulation equipment and data acquisition system, and includes the experimental procedures, fault simulation and data acquisition methods. Valves failures can be diagnosed by collecting detailed data and analyzing the behavior of electric gate valves in the event of a fault. The results of the study show that the fault of the valves can be diagnosed by the characteristic parameters corresponding to the electric gate valves.

articleTitle: Lightweight Surface Defect Detection Algorithm Based on Improved YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In response to the current issues of low detection accuracy and slow detection speed of detection algorithms in detecting surface defects on metal surfaces, a lightweight surface defect detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed. Firstly, a lightweight spatial attention module is introduced into the SPP module to extract effective information in the spatial dimension. Secondly, a new feature fusion network Amsf is designed to replace the original feature fusion network, which integrates feature information of different scales. Furthermore, the FAM attention mechanism is added to this network to enhance the detection capability for different types of targets. Finally, the SIoU loss function is used to replace the GIoU loss function to reduce boundary loss errors and improve the accuracy of target localization. Experimental results show that the improved model achieves an average detection accuracy of 81.97% on the NEU-DET dataset, which is 7.74% higher than YOLOv5. The model size and detection speed are comparable to YOLOv5. Effective improvement in detection accuracy is achieved while ensuring detection speed.

articleTitle: Frequency Maximum Deviation of a Damped Power System Disturbance Based on a First-Order Governor Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The maximum frequency deviation in a power system following a disturbance is a critical aspect of frequency security and stability analysis. This paper presents a mathematical model for the maximum frequency deviation in a damped power system after a disturbance, which is based on an equivalent first-order model of the governor system. Building upon the traditional step response model, the dynamic models of individual governor systems are equivalently represented as first-order models. Various forms of linearization approximations are employed to handle the feedback inputs of the governor systems, enabling an open-loop treatment within the closed-loop model framework of frequency response. Consequently, a mathematical model for the maximum frequency deviation and its corresponding time in the coupled system is established based on the boundary conditions at the moment of the maximum frequency deviation occurrence. By inputting the parameters of each governor and the magnitude of the disturbance, the maximum frequency deviation can be directly computed without the need for solving nonlinear equations, significantly reducing computation time. Furthermore, the proposed method's computational accuracy has been validated in subsequent verification. The proposed algorithm is validated through simulations using a three-machine nine-bus system in PowerFactory, demonstrating its capability to rapidly and accurately calculate the maximum frequency deviation in a damped power system after a disturbance.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic Design and Analysis of Permanent Magnet-Assisted Synchronous Reluctance Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To improve the electromagnetic performance of a three-phase synchronous reluctance motor (SynRM), a 4-pole, 36-slot permanent magnet-assisted synchronous reluctance motor is designed in this paper by embedding a permanent magnet in its rotor reluctance(PMaSynRM). The motor's no-load performance and load performance are analyzed by electromagnetic simulation using the finite element method. Finally, for the motor's output torque pulsation, reverse potential harmonics, two schemes, stator slant slot, and stator side open auxiliary slot optimization, are used to optimize the motor, which reduces the motor's reverse potential harmonics and torque pulsation.

articleTitle: Model-based Automated Safety Analysis Method for Safety-critical System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In safety-critical systems, the repercussions of system failures can be dire, encompassing significant losses in terms of human lives, property damage, and environmental impact. As systems grow in complexity, the burden of conducting safety analyses escalates as well. To streamline the system development process and alleviate this workload, automated safety analysis methods are indispensable. In this paper, we introduce an innovative automated safety analysis technique that hinges on the iterative utilisation of Failure Mode and Effects Analysis (FMEA) and Fault Tree Analysis (FTA) – termed the FMEA and FTA iterative analysis (FMEA-FTAia). Central to FMEA-FTAia is the integration of the system model with the system failure model, establishing a cohesive linkage to the fault tree model for unified change management. While FMEA delves into an exhaustive examination of component failure modes, FTA pinpoints vulnerabilities within the system. By integrating FMEA and FTA, a comprehensive safety analysis framework is formed. Additionally, in this article we propose a novel fault tree generation methodology. Furthermore, we discuss a model-based tool – FMEA-FTAia tool – designed to support the implementation of FMEA-FTAia and facilitate efficient safety analysis processes. And we designed the Analysis Architecture Metamodel (SAAM) to support FMEA-FTAia tool.

articleTitle: Temporal sequence Digital Image Correlation based on RNN-Conv3D
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Digital Image Correlation (DIC) is a non-contact optical measurement method widely used in material mechanics and solid mechanics. Recent research has overcome some of the limitations of traditional DIC methods through convolutional neural networks. However, these methods seem to overlook the temporal continuity of displacement. Therefore, this paper aims to develop a deep learning-based solution that considers time continuity to optimize the performance of DIC. Firstly, this paper designs a convolutional neural network called RC3D-DICNet for measuring displacement fields corresponding to speckle image sequences. Secondly, based on Hermite elements, a method is proposed to generate speckle image sequences and real displacement field sequences. This approach is compared the latest deep learning methods through comparative experiments and result analysis conducted on self-built datasets. The results indicate that our proposed method achieves the highest average measurement accuracy. Furthermore, through star displacement field measurement experiments, it was found that our method performs better in spatial resolution.

articleTitle: Optimization of Milling Paths for Engine Remanufacturing Cylinder Block External Attachment Mounting Surface Based on Improved Ant Colony Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents an enhanced ant colony algorithm to optimize the machining path of the mounting surface of external attachments on remanufactured engine blocks. Utilizing 3D scanning, the cylinder block model is acquired, and machining coordinates are reverse processed. The tool path problem is then converted into a Traveling Salesman Problem (TSP). The shortcomings of the ant colony algorithm are addressed by incorporating dynamically selected pheromone update rules and a global update strategy, enhancing its global search capability. The max-min ant system is introduced to elevate convergence speed, while boosting pheromone concentration on critical processing areas. Simulation and experimental results demonstrate a 0.18% reduction in path length compared to traditional ACO algorithms, with a remarkable decrease in iterations by 91.67% and iteration time by 52.79%. This experimentation validates the efficacy of the enhanced ant colony algorithm, significantly reducing machining time and enhancing the efficiency and quality of remanufactured cylinder block machining.

Author Keywords: Engine block external attachment mounting surface

articleTitle: Research and Design of Control System for Nuclear Track Membrane Wastewater Treatment
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Nuclear track membrane is also known as heavy ion microporous membrane, it is the use of heavy ions in the insulating material film punched holes and then chemically etched and enlarged, known as the world’s most sophisticated filter membrane. Through the study, the nuclear track membrane as the base net of dynamic tubular membrane has better filtration effect and shorter film formation time, and easier to clean, compared with the spongy structure of non-woven fabric, the nuclear track membrane has a regular shape (straight-through holes) and a uniform size, it is easy to form a uniform layer of sludge cake on the surface and the particles are not easy to get into the interior of the filtration membrane. Therefore, this paper proposes to use the nuclear track membrane as the base network of the dynamic membrane, form a mud cake layer on the surface of the nuclear pore membrane, use the mud cake layer to filter the sewage in the environmental engineering, and then use the filter membrane tubes to combine into the filtration assembly, and finally set into a fully automated sewage treatment system. In this system, the control system occupies an important position, using self-developed control software to achieve the functions of autonomous membrane cleaning, automated real-time detection of water quality, unattended and automated sewage treatment. This paper begins with the study of membrane components, detailed study of the design process of this wastewater treatment system, provides a complete set of wastewater treatment system construction programmed.

articleTitle: Design and Experiment of Thyristor Drive Circuit for CRATF Superconducting Magnet Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The high-power converter for the Comprehensive. Research Facility for Fusion Technology (CRAFT) magnet power supply has a DC output current of 30 kA and a voltage of 250 V. The use of good performance drive circuit can make the thyristor work in a more ideal switching state, shorten the switching time, reduce the switching loss, which has an important significance on the operation efficiency, reliability and safety of the converter device, which makes the design of the drive circuit more important. In this paper, for the requirements of CRAFT superconducting magnet power converter, a set of strong triggering final drive circuit can be designed for the thyristor of the converter to meet the requirements. After receiving the trigger signal from the control system, the final drive circuit outputs a strong departure current with a peak value of about 4A, a current rise rate of about 1.15A/μs, and a gate current plateau value of about 0.8A, which can turn on the thyristor quickly and stably.

articleTitle: Periodic Event-Triggered Sub-Optimal LQR Control of Disturbed System with a Dynamic Threshold Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper develops a periodic dynamic event-triggered suboptimal control method for continuous-time linear disturbed systems. Contrary to the continuous monitoring of trigger conditions in optimal event trigger control, this method can adjust the trigger difficulty at fixed intervals to improve information utilization, thereby reducing the relative error between the optimal cost and the sub-optimal cost. Firstly, the control gain is determined by employing the algebraic Riccati equation based on the disturbed system. Subsequently, a periodic dynamic event triggered mechanism is proposed to achieve sub-optimization, which is only evaluated at a fixed sampling period. Then, the selected interval of the sampling period is established based on the continuous form of the trigger mechanism. Furthermore, while ensuring the stability of the closed-loop system, the mathematical relationship between the suboptimal cost and the optimal cost is analyzed. Finally, the effectiveness of this approach is validated through simulations conducted on an electric vehicle charging system.

articleTitle: Real-Time Trajectory Planning for UAVs Perching on the Time-Varying Attitude Moving Platform
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the context of aerial-ground cooperation systems, the need for energy replenishment on mobile platforms arises due to UAVs’ limited endurance. However, the actual challenges in UAV landing in complex terrains is the time-varying attitudes of the mobile platform. Current studies primarily assume flat or sloping surfaces, neglecting the problem of time-varying flatness for UAV perching on intricate terrains. Addressing this gap, we proposed real-time trajectory planning method considers the changing attitude of the ground platform, ensuring consistent UAV attitude during landing and maintaining uniform terminal angular velocities to prevent collisions.

articleTitle: A Novel Deformable Wheel-leg Robot Design and Simulation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents the design and simulation of a novel deformable wheel-leg robot, a cutting-edge advancement in robotic mobility. Merging the stability of wheel-based locomotion with the versatility of legged movement, this robot stands as a significant innovation in crossing complex terrains. The research encompasses a comprehensive design approach, focusing on a unique transformation mechanism that facilitates seamless transition between wheel and leg modes. Utilizing SOLIDWORKS2020 and Adams View 2018, the design process involved extensive simulations to validate the robot's dynamics and functional capabilities. The outcome demonstrates a versatile robot with superior adaptability, capable of efficient movement in diverse environments. This study contributes valuable insights into wheel-leg robotics, offering potential applications in areas like disaster rescue and exploration of challenging terrains.

articleTitle: Calculation and Analysis of Influencing Factors of Oil Friction Loss in Submersible Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The submersible motor serves as the power unit for the submersible electric pump system, operating within a harsh environment. Typically, submersible motors are oil-cooled using special lubricating oil. Due to the viscosity of this lubricating oil, oil frictional loss in submersible motors constitutes a significant portion of mechanical loss, especially at higher rotational speeds. Previous research on oil frictional loss in submersible motors has mainly focused on rotor oil frictional loss, neglecting the potential impact of hollow shaft oil frictional loss on the temperature rise of the submersible motor. Therefore, further analysis and verification are necessary.
