To accurately analyze the temperature field of the submersible oil motor, this study utilizes numerical calculations based on the principles of fluid dynamics and coupled heat transfer. Three-dimensional fluid field and temperature field of the motor are investigated, and factors including the rotational speed of the submersible motor, the temperature of the lubricating oil, the roughness of the rotor wall surface, and the stator-rotor eccentricity are considered. The research contributes to a deeper understanding of the effects on the oil frictional loss in submersible motor.

articleTitle: A Novel Two-axis Lorentz Actuator: Parametric Design and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Lorentz actuators are widely used in active vibration isolation systems (AVISs) to create an ultra-quiet environment for sensitive payloads. However, traditional Lorentz actuators are single degree-of-freedom (DOF), and they also have limitations in terms of thrust and lightweight design. Typically, for a 6-DOF AVIS, at least 6 single-axis Lorentz actuators (SALAs) are required. When multiple SALAs are used simultaneously, the cumulative response time and position error cannot be ignored. To address this issue, a novel two-axis Lorentz actuator (TALA) was developed. The interaction effects between the two coils and the parametric effects of the proposed TALA were analyzed using the finite element method (FEM). To verify this, thrust and consistency experiments were conducted on multiple manufactured TALAs. The experimental results showed good linearity and matched well with the FEM values, validating the effectiveness of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Non-Regenerative Braking Strategy for Capacitor-free IPMSM Driver Considering Energy Dynamic Balance
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper proposes a non-regenerative braking strategy for Capacitor-free Drivers and systems with small inertia. By planning the stator current trajectory through braking power limitation, current limitation, and voltage limitation, the strategy maximizes copper loss during the braking process while maintaining stable bus voltage. On this basis, dynamic energy compensation is carried out using fuzzy logic, which calculates the d-axis current compensation value based on the bus voltage deviation and the rate of change of the q-axis current as feedback signals. This dynamic adjustment of copper loss helps to maintain a balance between braking power and dissipated power, preventing voltage fluctuations caused by errors in energy control and changes in motor parameters. Since this scheme does not require an exact stator current trajectory, it is also applicable to computationally complex interior permanent magnet synchronous motors (IPMSMs).

articleTitle: Power Compensation Control Method for a New Type of the Three-Phase Cascaded PV System under Shadow Conditions
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: A cascaded PV system is an extension application of cascaded rectifiers, where every PV module is a direct current source, which is connected in series after being inverted by an inverter. Through certain control methods, it can achieve the maximum power output of each component and also make the system's inverter output multi-level voltage, which can effectively reduce current harmonics. First, the control of the cascaded PV system under shadow conditions is explored, then the MPPT control of the cascaded system is studied, which can achieve the maximum power output of all components under local shadow conditions, thereby bringing about the problem of three-phase power imbalance, which is solved by adding power imbalance compensation measures.

articleTitle: A Novel Control Method for MMC-HVDC under Wind Farm Integration
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper introduces the principle of the high-voltage DC transmission (HVDC) based on Modular Multilevel Converter (MMC) and analyzes the MMC-HVDC system for wind farm integration, as well as its simplified structure. The rectifier station of the MMC adopts constant AC voltage control, while the inverter station adopts constant DC current voltage control. The control methods are simulated and verified, and the effectiveness of circulating current suppression strategy in the simplified structure is also validated.

articleTitle: Design of Remote Diagnosis System for Starting Performance of Gyro Compass Based on C/S Mode
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to help the maritime regulatory authorities and maintenance personnel analyze whether the gyro compass is in the normal starting state during the epidemic, eliminate potential safety hazards, and provide safety guarantee for the normal navigation of intelligent ships; A remote diagnosis system for the starting performance of gyro compass based on C/S mode is designed and developed: using computer network technology, the starting data of gyro compass on board is transmitted to the shore client in real time, the damping curve of gyro compass is updated and displayed in real time, and the three performance index data of damping period, damping factor and stability time are calculated automatically, By analyzing the starting performance parameters of gyro compass, the purpose of remote diagnosis of gyro compass is achieved; The experimental results show that the system can quickly and automatically realize the remote performance diagnosis of gyro compass, and provide a non-contact means for relevant personnel to detect gyro compass.

articleTitle: Research on Harmonic Elimination Method for Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motors Based on Improved Particle Swarm Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents a PMSM harmonic elimination method that incorporates dead-time compensation, aiming to eliminate PMSM harmonics during operation while considering the effects of dead-time. The harmonic elimination is achieved by inserting a compensation into the PWM duty cycle, where the phase of the compensated PWM matches the phase of the harmonic current, and the amplitude is opposite to that of the harmonic current. Initially, the paper analyzes the impact of the dead-time effect and the delay on motor control, which mainly affects the amplitude and phase. Subsequently, the voltage expressions for the 5<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> and 7<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup> harmonics are derived. Finally, a current compensation strategy based on an improved particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is proposed. This method is characterized by its low complexity and strong robustness, making it adaptable to various operating conditions and achieving excellent control performance. Experimental results validate the superiority and effectiveness of the algorithm.

articleTitle: Development of Spraying Robot Based on Large Metal Tank Operation
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the improvement of the demand and quality requirements for large metal tanks, anti-corrosion spraying operation has become an indispensable part. This paper mainly analyzes the development and application of the overall structure of the spraying wall-climbing robot. Firstly, the overall structure design and the design selection of each part are analyzed. Then, based on the structure, the mechanical model is established to analyze the torque of the robot walking. Finally, the application and prospect of spraying wall-climbing robot are introduced. These studies provide a theoretical basis for the spraying operation of robots.

articleTitle: Research on Load Distribution Control System for Multiple Asynchronous Motors Based on Variable-Frequency Regulating Speed Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of uneven load distribution of multiple motors in the drive system of large profile steel straightener, a load distribution control system model of multiple asynchronous motors is established in this paper. The model takes the mean value of the current component of the stator current as the key control object, and adjusts the torque component of the stator current in each motor by feedback based on the asynchronous motor vector control technology. Then the software control system of the motor load distribution is developed, so as to realize the real-time dynamic load distribution of each motor. The practical application results show that the control model solves the problem of uneven load distribution of multiple motors in the drive system of large profile steel straightener straightener, and the control system has good dynamic and steady performance.

Author Keywords: asynchronous motor load distribution control system variable-frequency regulating speed technology Vector control profile steel straightener

articleTitle: Motion Control Study of a Quadruped Robot Based on Gazebo
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In order to improve the stability and robustness of the quadruped robot during its motion, this paper proposes a method of model prediction to control the motion of the quadruped robot. Firstly, the single rigid body dynamics model of the quadruped robot is established to obtain the relationship between the state of the quadruped robot motion and the end-foot force, the end-foot force required by the quadruped robot is calculated by the model prediction controller, the single rigid body dynamics problem of the quadruped robot is transformed into a convex optimization problem with constraints, and the moments of each joint are obtained by the Jacobi matrix and the end-foot force to realize the stable motion of the quadruped robot. Finally, through the Gazebo in ROS to realize the stable walking in the complex terrain such as gravel road, one-sided bridge, etc., the results show that the control method can effectively control the stable movement of the quadruped robot in the gravel road.

articleTitle: Development and Verification of Thrust and Torque Integrated Instrument for Ship Model Shafting
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: At present, the vast majority of high-precision thrust and torque measurement equipment for ship models on the market are foreign products, which are not only costly but also limited by import control, which brings a lot of trouble to ship research and design. In view of this, this paper designs an integrated thrust and torque measuring instrument based on strain gauge sensitive element, which mainly includes the instrument structure, thrust and torque measuring unit. The instrument structure is made of high-strength stainless steel to ensure stability and reliability in extreme environments. The strain measurement unit utilizes highly sensitive strain gauges, which can accurately capture small deformations due to thrust and torque by applying them to key locations in the shaft system. Thrust is measured by mounting the strain gauges directly on the bearing housing of the ship's model. When the bearing is subjected to the thrust generated by the operation of the ship's propeller, the strain gauges are deformed, and this change is accurately transmitted to the data processing unit through an electrical signal. The torque is measured using another set of strain gauges set on the drive shaft. When the shaft is rotated, it is subjected to different degrees of torque, and the deformation of the strain gauges will reflect the magnitude of the torque. Accuracy test results show that the accuracy of the device is basically comparable to foreign instruments, which can effectively solve the current small-range push torque integrated measurement instrument monopolized by foreign countries, which is of great significance.

articleTitle: Principle and Design of small Power Claw-Type Bearingless Permanent Magnet Slice Motor
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the design requirements of the small power bearingless permanent magnet lamellar motor, firstly, the principle of the motor and the mathematical model of levitation force are introduced, then the stator and rotor are designed based on the theoretical calculations and finite element simulation, and the torque winding and levitation winding are designed with the objectives of torque and levitation force. Combined with the actual engineering heart blood pump medical devices, proposed claw-shaped stator core structure, higher freedom of stator tooth size parameters compared to bearingless slice motors, and it generates more levitation., because the claw-type three-dimensional magnetic circuit structure is more special, in accordance with the actual process processing convenience as well as the cost of the problem, the SMC material has a magnetic and thermal isotropic characteristics, and molding is easy, but the material permeability is low, this paper proposes a SMC-Si combination of the core and the Si core of the two structures, compared with the electromagnetic performance, radial suspension force, suspension force pulsation and other objectives of the motor torque windings and suspension windings. force, levitation force pulsation and other parameters of the output performance, and electromagnetic simulation of axial passive levitation force stiffness, in order to ensure that the rotor can realize stable levitation.

Author Keywords: Claw-type bearingless permanent magnet slice motors

articleTitle: Frontend Solutions for Micro Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the development of business digitization, large-scale Web application system is becoming more and more complex, front-end application needs to undertake more content, more and more complex functions, resulting in development cooperation, security isolation and other problems. In order to solve the problem of large front-end development, the industry has carried out various explorations, from MPA (multi-page application) to SPA (single-page application), although the delay problem caused by switching pages is solved, but the first load time is too long and new problems such as boulder application. The natural isolation between the components of MPA (multi-page application) can be independently developed and deployed, which can just solve the problem of megaliths, and split a megaliths application into multiple applications for development. The micro front end combines the advantages of the two, which can solve the problem of switching page delay of MPA (multi-page application) and avoid the problem of SPA (single-page application) boulder application. This paper describes the development and value of micro-front end, introduces the principle of micro-front end in detail, and compares the current mainstream micro-front end framework in the industry.

articleTitle: A Review of LSSVM Mathematical Models and Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Least Squares Support Vector Machines (LSSVM) is an extension algorithm of the standard Support Vector Machines (SVM), which takes the least squares system as the loss function and transforms the original quadratic programming problem into a linear problem for solving, which greatly reduces the computational complexity. The complexity of operation is greatly reduced, and the topic has emerged as a focal point of research in the realm of machine learning. This paper reviews the theoretical foundation and research status of least squares support vector machine, and analyzes in detail the application of LSSVM in the fields of fault diagnosis, network intrusion, and medical treatment.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Tool Setting Method for Complex Working Conditions Based on Combined Visual/Tactile Control
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of low tool setting efficiency and control accuracy in the existing intelligent tool setting methods, this paper proposes an intelligent tool setting method based on Vision/Haptic interaction control. The method quickly and initially locates to the initial position of the haptic tool setting through vision, and then uses the haptic tool setting to search for precise positioning at a slow speed, which improves the tool setting efficiency under the guarantee of tool setting accuracy. First of all, the blade vision fast positioning module is built, using canny algorithm for edge detection, for the problem that the image quality collected under different working conditions is different and the fixed voting parameters of the Hough transform method may cause the loss of contour features or misjudgment, the Hough plus clustering method is utilized to improve the robustness of the algorithm in identifying the contour, and to realize the fast positioning of the blade force sense to the origin of the blade; Secondly, based on the material parameters and geometric model to establish the end face grinding force model, instead of the actual sampling results, the rise time, adjustment time and maximum overshooting amount as the optimization objectives, combined with the particle swarm algorithm to optimize the parameters of the PID controller, which in turn improves the tactile tool setting control accuracy and efficiency; Finally, the tool setting algorithm is verified by building an experimental platform. The experimental results show that the method can realize accurate automatic tool setting quickly and stably, and the tool setting error can be controlled within 0.01mm.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Artificial Intelligence in Equipment Manufacturing
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: New-generation intelligent manufacturing is the core driving force of the new round of industrial revolution and the main path for the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry. Equipment manufacturing, as the core and foundation of the manufacturing industry, is an important field and hotspot issue of the New-generation intelligent manufacturing. This paper, by summarizing and organizing relevant literature, elaborates on the current main artificial intelligence technologies from the perspective of Human-cyber-physical systems (HCPSs). It analyzes the current application status and development trends of artificial intelligence technology in equipment manufacturing, focusing on the application in path planning, image processing, fault diagnosis, and other aspects in equipment manufacturing, and concludes with prospects for the future.

articleTitle: Current Status of Bridge Cable Climbing Robot Technology and Design of Cable Corrosion Detection Device
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Based on the issues of cable inspection and maintenance for cable-stayed bridges, this paper conducts research on the mature intelligent cable robot technology on the market, and briefly analyzes and summarizes the structural characteristics and power drive advantages and disadvantages of different robots. A bridge cable corrosion detection device is designed to address the limitations of traditional bridge cable detection methods, which can be equipped with non-destructive testing equipment to detect the corrosion status of bridge cables. Compared with existing technology, it has the following advantages: (1) the cable is inserted between the auxiliary mechanism and the second detection plate, the driver is activated, and the output end of the driver drives the screw to rotate, causing the displacement plate to move downwards and drive it to move downwards with the fixed plate, so that the first detection plate is continuously close to the cable, and the cable is clamped between the first detection plate and the second detection plate, Enable the device to quickly clamp with the cable, improving detection efficiency; (2) Start the detector, so that the first detection board and several detectors can detect the corrosion status of the cable. The data detected by the detection needle is imported into the detector through two wires, and the data detected by the first detection board is imported into the detector through sensors. By accurately judging the corrosion status of the cable through the two sets of data detected, the detection quality of the cable is improved.

articleTitle: Research on Secondary Equipment Configuration of Power System Suitable for New Energy Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This article introduces the operating characteristics and startup methods of distributed synchronous condenser-transformer unit, and proposes their protection configurations during the startup process. And the principle and logic of different demagnetization protection, power-off protection, and third harmonic stator grounding protection between distributed synchronous condenser-transformer unit and conventional generators were emphasized. At the same time, referring to national norms and standards, a relay protection configuration scheme for distributed synchronous condenser-transformer unit has been proposed, providing reference for the construction of new energy station installation of distributed synchronous condenser-transformer unit projects.

articleTitle: Autonomous Mobile Robot Path Planning Based on Improved DWA for Following Human Inside Staircase
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of difficult to locate the tracking target position and loss of the tracking target point in the process of assisting firefighters' disaster relief tasks for the stair-climbing robot, a path planning method based on the improved DWA for the staircase environment is proposed. By applying the pull-wire sensor information installed in the gimbal and the LiDAR information, the target tracking and localization and the motion phase division are realized. By analyzing the motion mode of stairs, the problem of target disappearance cannot complete path planning is found. By appropriately selecting the midpoint between straight line and turn in the staircase environment, this problem is overcome. For the problem of constant weight dynamic window approach (DWA), which has obstacle avoidance failure and unreasonable path, an improved DWA is proposed by considering the human body tracking constraints and combining with the segmented path planning method. The simulation results show that the proposed method can accomplish the real-time following of a human by a robot in a staircase environment.

articleTitle: Research on the Method of Universal Forklift Pallet Detection and Pose Estimation Based on Visual and 3D Point Cloud Fusion
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: As logistics demands surge and labor costs rise, the industry turns to intelligent automation. Autonomous forklifts, key in this shift, autonomously transport goods to cut costs and boost efficiency. Pallet detection is undoubtedly a key step in achieving automatic forklifts. Traditional pallet detection methods, relying on single data modalities like images or 3D point clouds, face challenges with accuracy due to lighting, occlusion, and real-time processing. This paper introduces a novel approach for pallet detection and pose estimation on forklifts, merging visual data with 3D point clouds. Using a depth camera, the method refines pallet location via improved YOLOv8 detection and fuses color and depth data for precise 3D localization. The results show high performance and reliability, promising for real-world industrial applications.

articleTitle: Integrated Air-Ground Fire Operation System
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: The presented project showcases an integrated air-ground fire operation system, incorporating a drone, a fire engine, and leveraging the STM32F407VGT6 as its central processing unit. This system autonomously conducts perimeter inspections, adhering to designated routes. Its key components include a laser radar for precise fire localization, and the Open Machine Vision (OPENMV) module, employed for navigating the heated area, with a real-time path display on the LCD screen communicated by the LORA system. Overall, the project demonstrates the drone's capability to undertake automated inspections and adhere precisely to specified routes while landing accurately within acceptable margins under varying conditions.

articleTitle: Performance Verification of Transcranial Magnetic Stimulation Robot Based on Spatial Feedback Control Model
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Objective: This article mainly introduces the performance verification of a new type of robot system used to cooperate with transcranial magnetic stimulation (TMS) treatment. It mainly verifies the practicality of target positioning and switching functions of the new TMS robot system, and the ability of the coil to track the target in the situation of simulated real head movement. Methods: The TMS robot platform tested in this article mainly consists of a six-degree-of-freedom robot and a homemade neuro-navigation system based on binocular cameras. A new spatial feedback control model was proposed, and each functional module of the robot system was tested through a three-dimensional head model carried by another six-degree-of-freedom robot which was applied to simulating patient head movement. Results: Using the new spatial feedback positioning model, the target positioning and target switching errors were less than 1mm. The synchronous tracking function of the TMS robot allows to achieve 23 mm of positioning accuracy with the speed of the test robot is 10% of the maximum speed and the head moving distance 20mm. Conclusion: The TMS robot system proposed in present study can achieve efficient target position and switching, as well as high-precision synchronous tracking. This research is of great significance for improving patient experience and promoting TMS robot-assisted clinical therapy.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Applied to Control of DC Drives
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper presents a comparative study and design of various controllers which are used for speed and position control of DC motor. Five controller design strategies and algorithms, especially those using artificial intelligent methods, are introduced and discussed including the conventional control strategies -- root locus and Ziegler-Nichols method, fuzzy logic control, genetic algorithm and a design strategy of on-line tuning of conventional PI controllers. Controllers using above design strategies are employed and simulated in software with test of their transient response and disturbance rejection capability as well as robustness against motor parameter variations. The summaries and comparisons between these controllers with different design strategies are also provided based on a performance index.

articleTitle: Optimization Algorithm for Data Transmission in the Vehicular Networking Based on Federated Edge Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In the context of Vehicle-to-Everything (V2X) communications, optimizing data transmission is crucial. This study uses evolutionary game theory to build a profit model for channel data transmission, focusing on data security requirements and privacy encryption costs. It aims to maximize overall benefits while ensuring data security and accuracy. A privacy-preserving federated learning algorithm is integrated, enabling effective information amalgamation across multiple data nodes while protecting privacy. The research also applies a profit function from federated edge learning and replicator dynamics to simulate competitive strategies, finding equilibrium in strategy selection. Simulation results demonstrate the strategy's effectiveness in V2X environments, offering theoretical and practical insights for enhancing network data transmission security and efficiency.

articleTitle: Intelligent Crane Safety Monitoring System Driven by Millimeter Wave Radar Waves and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: With the development of industrial automation technology, improving the safety of heavy machinery equipment, such as intelligent cranes, has become an important research field. This study designed and evaluated an intelligent crane safety management system that integrates millimeter wave radar and artificial intelligence technology, aiming to monitor the surrounding environment of the crane in real-time and predict potential safety risks. The system uses millimeter wave radar in the 77 GHz frequency band for high-precision obstacle detection, and analyses radar data using support vector machines (SVM) and random forest (RF) models to achieve real-time risk prediction and decision-making. The experimental results show that the system performs excellently in various performance tests, with an average response time of 180 milliseconds, a detection accuracy of 97%, a false alarm rate controlled within 2.5%, and the ability to issue warnings an average of 4.5 seconds in advance after identifying risks. These results validate the effectiveness of the fusion of millimeter wave radar technology and machine learning methods in improving the safety of intelligent crane operation. This study not only provides valuable experience for the design and implementation of an intelligent crane safety management system, but also lays a solid foundation for further research and practical application.

articleTitle: Research on Product Modeling and Design Path Driven by Artificial Intelligence Based on Kansei Engineering and TOPSIS
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This article explores academic literature both domestically and internationally, and organizes knowledge related to users’ perceptual cognitive measurement and its design applications. When facing the problems in traditional users’ perception measurement, deep research should be conducted in two aspects. Firstly, it is necessary to pay attention to the increasement in sample collection volume and the comprehensiveness of measurement. Secondly, we should continue to explore the correlation between users' perceptual cognition and their measurement applications. To address these issues, this article proposes a product design path based on Kansei Engineering and TOPSIS, which is driven by artificial intelligence. By translating the subjective evaluation results of users into design specifications, it can provide strong guidance for product design. In order to verify the effectiveness of this method, a seat design is selected as a case study. The research results indicate that this path aims to deeply tap into user perception, help designers comprehensively understand users’ needs, and provide solutions that better meet user expectations and satisfaction, thereby enhancing users' psychological identification with the product and enhancing its competitiveness in the market.

articleTitle: Design Methodology of a Flexible Contour Tracing Mobile Welding Robot for Complex Surface Welds
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Intelligent manufacturing has revolutionized the transformation and upgrading of the manufacturing industry. Amid this transformation, outdoor welding of intricate steel structures is becoming more common, posing challenges to traditional welding robots. Limited by their mobility and adaptability to curved surfaces, current welding robots often fall short. To overcome this, we have proposed a design methodology for a flexible contour tracing mobile welding robot, specifically designed for welding seams on such complex surfaces. We've developed two prototypes, one for 8-shaped expandable convoluted pipes and another for nuclear power turbine guide rings. Rigorous testing has confirmed their excellence in weld formation and quality, thereby validating the practicality and effectiveness of our proposed design. This innovative approach can be extended to various other seams, serving as a valuable blueprint for developing specialized mobile welding robots in complex working environments.

articleTitle: Active Noise Resistance and Time-Delay Control of Quadrotor UAVs Based on a Novel Composite Fractional-Order PID Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: In response to the issues of low control accuracy and poor stability caused by wind disturbance and control time delays in quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs), we utilizes a multi-channel decoupled state space model of a quadrotor UAV. A method using time-delay compensation fractional-order PID (TCFOPID) controllers to adjust the response curves was proposed, enhancing the system’s adaptability to wind disturbance and time delays.Given the time-varying nature of control time delays and the limitations of fixed-parameter FOPID performance, this study designed a quadrotor UAV control algorithm based on the Actor-Critic (AC) reinforcement learning with a fractional-order PID that can update PID parameters and time-delay compensation parameters online. Simulation experiments show that this control algorithm achieves favorable control outcomes, demonstrating its effectiveness in managing the dynamic challenges posed by wind disturbance rejection and time delays in UAV control systems.

articleTitle: Research and Analysis on Prediction of Welding Deformation of Flange Plate of Loading Wheel
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Welding deformation prediction predicts the deformation that may occur during the welding process, the corresponding measures can be taken to control the deformation. In this paper, the finite element analysis software is used to simulate the welding process of the load wheel flange plate of the special vehicle body. Based on the finite element analysis method, the welding deformation data set under different welding voltage, welding current and welding speed is obtained. The process parameters of orthogonal experimental design are used for welding, and the deformation of the flange plate of the loading wheel after welding is measured by three-dimensional laser scanner. The welding deformation simulation results are in good agreement with the experimental results, so the finite element simulation method in this paper can better reflect the actual welding deformation. In order to improve the efficiency and accuracy of welding deformation prediction, a deformation prediction model based on improved genetic algorithm optimized BP neural network (improved GA-BP) is proposed. Finally, the improved GA-BP algorithm model is used to verify the engineering verification of the flange plate of the load wheel obtained by the welding experiment. Based on the improved GA-BP neural network, the error between the predicted value of the welding deformation and the average value of the experimental measurement is within 9%, and the predicted value is consistent with the experimental measurement value. The application value of the improved GA-BP neural network in engineering is verified.

articleTitle: Study on AC Asymmetric Fault Control Strategy of MMC-HVDC Based on CRC and PI-IVPI Bridge Arm Current Decoupling
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: To solve the problem of unified control of AC side current and circulating current of MMC-HVDC when asymmetric fault occurs in AC power grid, in accordance with three kinds of current control information of bridge arm current, including DC current, AC side output current of converter and circulating current, a control strategy for AC asymmetric fault of MMC-HVDC based on complex resonant controller (CRC) and the hybrid controller based on proportional integral (PI) and improved vector proportional integral (IVPI) resonant regulator is proposed. For the coupling problem between the current and the voltage bridge arm which is difficult to calculate, a decoupling network based on feedforward compensation method which can simplify the control structure is constructed. Under the two-phase static coordinate system, a calculation method of bridge arm current reference value based on CRC sequence component extraction is proposed. Finally, a PI-IVPI1-IVPI2 controller with bandwidth cut-off frequency is proposed is proposed to control three kinds of current effectively and reduce the use of additional controller. Simulation results of MMC-HVDC model by MATLAB/simulink show that the CRC component extraction method proposed in this paper can quickly extract positive and negative sequence components when unbalanced faults occur in power system; the PI-IVPI1-IVPI2 controller with bandwidth cut-off frequency can effectively suppress negative sequence and double frequency circulating current, and reduce the fluctuation of DC current.

articleTitle: Research on the Online Mobile Machining Equipment and System for Hydroelectric Generator Rotor Flange End Face
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: This paper aims to address the challenges in the processing of the end face of the water turbine generator casing flange, and proposes a method for the on-site high-precision end face profile processing of large-diameter components based on a mobile platform. According to the proposed scheme, a mobile processing device for the end face profile of large-diameter components will be developed and applied to the inspection and processing of the end face of the casing flange of large hydroelectric generating units, the processing of the stator lower ring plate, the processing of the mounting flange of the thrust bearing bracket, the processing of the brake flange, and the processing of the stator housing mounting flange. This will effectively solve the problem of on-site processing of the end face of large-diameter components, improve the processing accuracy, reduce the processing cost, and provide a solution for the on-site processing of similar large-scale electrical and mechanical equipment.

articleTitle: A Fabric Layer Grasping Robotic Hand Inspired by the Cooperative Mechanism of Human Fingertip-Fingerpad
publicationTitle: 2024 5th International Conference on Mechatronics Technology and Intelligent Manufacturing (ICMTIM)
abstract: Addressing the layer-by-layer separation challenge in the production of garments with multiple stacked fabric layers, this study proposes a layered grasping robotic hand inspired by human hand actions in cloth grasping. Firstly, human hand actions are decomposed into two stages: fingertip and finger pad grasping, with an analysis of the underlying principles. Secondly, a two-drive-source, three-degreeof-freedom robotic hand configuration is designed, incorporating a fabric bending deformation model under the robotic hand’s actions. Finally, experiments are conducted to validate the arching and grasping of several typical elastic fabrics. Results demonstrate that the robotic hand achieves a single-layer grasping success rate of over 90%, enabling fabric manipulation akin to human hands. The proposed robotic hand satisfies the requirements for layered grasping, showcasing promising practical applications in fabric handling.
